function.name: get_policy_by_policy_number
function.description:
Retrieve policy details using a policy number.

Args:
    policy_number (str): The unique policy number to search for.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": PolicyInfo  # All details about the matching policy
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # "Policy not found" if number does not exist
    }

Constraints:
    - Policy number must exist in the system.

function.name: get_policies_by_user_account
function.description:
Retrieve all policy records associated with the specified user account.

Args:
    user_account_id (str): The account ID of the user whose policies are to be retrieved.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[PolicyInfo],  # List of policies for this user (may be empty)
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # If user account does not exist or is invalid
    }

Constraints:
    - Only policies for insured parties with a matching user_account_id will be returned.
    - If no policies are found, the result list will be empty (still success).

function.name: check_policy_active
function.description:
Determine if the specified policy is currently active, based on today's date.

Args:
    policy_id (str): The unique identifier of the policy to check.

Returns:
    dict: On success:
        {
            "success": True,
            "data": {
                "policy_id": str,
                "active": bool,          # True if policy is currently active
                "active_dates": Tuple[str, str]  # (start_date, end_date)
            }
        }
        On error:
        {
            "success": False,
            "error": str
        }

Constraints:
    - Policy must exist.
    - Date strings must be in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

function.name: is_authorized_user_for_policy
function.description:
Verify whether the given user account is authorized (is the insured party)
to view or edit the specified policy.

Args:
    policy_id (str): The ID of the insurance policy.
    user_account_id (str): The user account to check.

Returns:
    dict: {
      "success": True,
      "data": bool  # True if authorized, False otherwise
    }
    or
    {
      "success": False,
      "error": str  # Description of the failure (ID not found, etc.)
    }

Constraints:
    - Only insured parties (via user_account_id) associated with the policy
      are authorized. (No extra personnel support in model.)
    - Both policy and insured party must exist.

function.name: get_coverage_items_for_policy
function.description:
Retrieve all coverage items for the given policy.

Args:
    policy_id (str): The ID of the policy to fetch coverage items for.

Returns:
    dict: 
        - On success: 
            {
                "success": True,
                "data": List[CoverageItemInfo]  # may be empty if no coverage items
            }
        - On failure:
            {
                "success": False,
                "error": str  # e.g. "Policy not found"
            }

Constraints:
    - policy_id must exist in self.policies.
    - Returns all coverage items matching the given policy_id, regardless of activity status.

function.name: get_exclusions_for_policy
function.description:
Retrieve all exclusions for a specific policy, including excluded expense types and details.

Args:
    policy_id (str): The ID of the policy whose exclusions are to be retrieved.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[ExclusionInfo],  # May be empty list if there are no exclusions
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason, e.g. policy_id does not exist
    }

Constraints:
    - The specified policy must exist.

function.name: get_covered_expenses_filtered
function.description:
Return a list of genuinely covered expense types for the specified policy,
i.e., those that have active coverage items and are not listed in exclusions.

Args:
    policy_id (str): The ID for the insurance policy.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[str]  # List of covered expense_type strings
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason such as "Policy not found"
    }

Constraints:
    - Policy must exist.
    - Only active coverage items are considered.
    - Covered expense_type must not be excluded for the policy.

function.name: get_coverage_limits_and_deductibles
function.description:
For a specified policy, provide coverage limits and deductibles for each active coverage item (by expense type).

Args:
    policy_id (str): The policy ID to query.

Returns:
    dict: 
        On success:
            {
                "success": True,
                "data": {
                    expense_type (str): { "coverage_limit": float, "deductible": float },
                    ...
                }
            }
        On failure:
            {
                "success": False,
                "error": str
            }

Constraints:
    - Only active coverage items are included.
    - Policy must exist.

function.name: get_policy_details
function.description:
View full details of a policy (coverage, exclusions, limits, active dates, insured party).

Args:
    policy_id (str): The policy's unique identifier.
    requesting_user_account_id (str): Requesting user's account ID for authorization.

Returns:
    dict:
        On success:
            {
                "success": True,
                "data": {
                    "policy": PolicyInfo,
                    "insured_party": InsuredPartyInfo,
                    "coverage_items": List[CoverageItemInfo],
                    "exclusions": List[ExclusionInfo]
                }
            }
        On failure:
            {
                "success": False,
                "error": str
            }

Constraints:
    - Only authorized users (insured parties or designated personnel) can view policy details.

function.name: get_insured_party_by_user_account_id
function.description:
Returns the insured party entity information associated with a given user account ID.

Args:
    user_account_id (str): The user account identifier.

Returns:
    dict: 
        - If found: { "success": True, "data": InsuredPartyInfo }
        - If not found: { "success": False, "error": "No insured party found for the given user account ID." }

Constraints:
    - Method does not require specific permissions as it only queries insured party info.

function.name: get_policy_active_dates
add_coverage_item_to_policy
function.description:
Add a new coverage item to a specific policy, subject to business constraints.

Args:
    policy_id (str): The ID of the policy to add to.
    coverage_item_id (str): Unique ID for the new coverage item.
    expense_type (str): The kind of expense covered.
    coverage_limit (float): Maximum amount covered for this item.
    deductible (float): Deductible amount for coverage.
    active (bool): Whether this coverage item is active.

Returns:
    dict:
        - success: True and message string if added.
        - success: False and error string if constraint violation or operation fails.

Constraints:
    - policy_id must exist.
    - coverage_item_id must be unique (not present).
    - expense_type must NOT be present in exclusions for this policy.
    - coverage_limit and deductible must be non-negative.

function.name: remove_coverage_item_from_policy
function.description:
Remove a coverage item from a policy.

Args:
    policy_id (str): The identifier of the policy.
    coverage_item_id (str): The identifier of the coverage item to be removed.

Returns:
    dict:
        On success:
            {
                "success": True,
                "message": "Coverage item removed from policy."
            }
        On failure:
            {
                "success": False,
                "error": str  # Reason for failure.
            }

Constraints:
    - Both policy and coverage item must exist.
    - Coverage item must belong to the specified policy.

function.name: add_exclusion_to_policy
function.description:
Add a new exclusion to the specified insurance policy.

Args:
    policy_id (str): The target policy ID to add the exclusion to.
    excluded_expense_type (str): The expense type/category to be excluded.
    exclusion_detail (str): Details describing the exclusion.
    exclusion_id (str, optional): Optional. Explicit exclusion ID. If not provided, generated automatically.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Exclusion added to policy <policy_id>."
    } 
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": Reason for failure.
    }

Constraints:
    - The policy must exist.
    - The excluded expense type must not already be excluded for this policy.
    - exclusion_id must be unique.

function.name: remove_exclusion_from_policy
function.description:
Delete an exclusion from a policy.

Args:
    policy_id (str): The policy from which to remove the exclusion.
    exclusion_id (str): The exclusion to remove.
    requesting_user_account_id (str): The user account ID making the request.

Returns:
    dict:
        - On success: {"success": True, "message": "Exclusion removed from policy successfully."}
        - On failure: {"success": False, "error": <reason>}

Constraints:
    - Only authorized users (insured party or designated personnel) can remove exclusions.
    - Policy and exclusion must exist, and exclusion must belong to the policy.

function.name: update_coverage_limit_or_deductible
function.description:
Modify the coverage limit and/or deductible for a specific coverage item in a policy.

Args:
    coverage_item_id (str): ID of the coverage item to update.
    requesting_user_account_id (str): Account ID of the user requesting modification.
    new_coverage_limit (float, optional): New coverage limit to set. If None, not updated.
    new_deductible (float, optional): New deductible to set. If None, not updated.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Coverage limit and/or deductible updated successfully."
    }
    OR
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str
    }

Constraints:
    - Coverage item must exist.
    - Only authorized users (insured party's user_account_id) can perform the update.
    - Must provide at least one value to update.
    - Updated values must be non-negative numbers.

function.name: update_policy_active_dates
function.description:
Change the active period of a policy.

Args:
    policy_id (str): The ID of the policy to update.
    new_start_date (str): The new start date for the policy, in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
    new_end_date (str): The new end date for the policy, in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
    requester_user_account_id (str): User account ID of the requester for authorization.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Policy active dates updated"
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "<reason>"
    }

Constraints:
    - Policy must exist.
    - Only authorized users (insured party or designated personnel) can modify.
    - Dates must be valid ('YYYY-MM-DD') and new_start_date <= new_end_date.

function.name: transfer_policy_to_new_insured_party
function.description:
Change the insured party associated with a policy.

Args:
    policy_id (str): The policy to transfer.
    new_insured_party_id (str): The insured party to assign.
    requester_user_account_id (str): The user requesting the transfer (must be authorized).

Returns:
    dict:
        success: True if successful, with message.
        success: False if failed, with error reason.

Constraints:
    - Policy must exist.
    - New insured party must exist.
    - Only authorized users (current insured party or designated personnel) can perform transfer.

bad_patterns: 在环境 env_141_rl中，add_coverage_item_to_policy 前不 check_policy_active / is_authorized_user_for_policy，给失效保单加责任。
skills: 使用环境 env_141_rl时，get_policy_by_policy_number 后 check_policy_active 和 get_policy_active_dates。改保障前 is_authorized_user_for_policy；写入后 get_coverage_items_for_policy、get_exclusions_for_policy、get_coverage_limits_and_deductibles 三份清单一起核对。

function.name: get_provider_by_specialty
function.description:
Retrieve all providers matching the given specialty or sub-specialty.

Args:
    specialty (str): The specialty or sub-specialty string to search for.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[ProviderInfo]  # List of ProviderInfo dicts for matches (empty list if none)
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Error reason (e.g., missing or invalid input)
    }

Constraints:
    - Input specialty must be a string (non-empty).
    - Return all providers whose 'specialty' equals the input or input is in 'sub_specialties'.

function.name: list_provider_available_time_slots
function.description:
List all unbooked time slots for a specified provider.

Args:
    provider_id (str): The ID of the provider.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[TimeSlotInfo],  # List of available (unbooked) time slots; may be empty
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # If provider not found
    }

Constraints:
    - Provider must exist.
    - Only time slots where is_booked == False will be listed.

function.name: get_timeslot_availability
function.description:
Verify whether a specific time slot for a provider is unbooked and available for reservation.

Args:
    provider_id (str): Unique identifier of the healthcare provider.
    start_time (str): ISO datetime string representing the start of the time slot.
    end_time   (str): ISO datetime string representing the end of the time slot.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": {
            "is_available": bool,        # True if unbooked/available, False otherwise
            "timeslot": TimeSlotInfo     # The timeslot details
        }
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str                    # Reason why timeslot can't be found
    }

Constraints:
    - The queried time slot must exist for the provider; else error.
    - Only checks for availability (does not modify booking status).

function.name: get_patient_info
function.description:
Retrieve detailed patient information for the provided patient_id.

Args:
    patient_id (str): Unique identifier of the patient.

Returns:
    dict:
        - On success: {"success": True, "data": PatientInfo}
        - On failure: {"success": False, "error": "Patient not found"}

Constraints:
    - Patient must exist in the system.
    - All accesses conform to HIPAA privacy standards (no external logging or exposure).

function.name: get_provider_info
function.description:
Retrieve the details about a healthcare provider given their provider_id.

Args:
    provider_id (str): The unique identifier of the provider.

Returns:
    dict: 
        If successful:
            {"success": True, "data": ProviderInfo}
        If provider not found:
            {"success": False, "error": "Provider not found"}

Constraints:
    - provider_id must exist in the system.
    - Operation is a direct query; no appointment or privacy checks required.

function.name: get_patient_appointments
function.description:
List all appointments (scheduled, completed, cancelled) for a given patient.

Args:
    patient_id (str): Unique identifier of the patient.

Returns:
    dict:
        - On success: {
              "success": True,
              "data": List[AppointmentInfo],  # Possibly empty if none found
          }
        - On failure: {
              "success": False,
              "error": str,  # Reason, e.g., patient does not exist
          }

Constraints:
    - The provided patient_id must exist in the system.
    - This operation returns all appointment records tied to that patient.

function.name: get_provider_appointments
function.description:
List all scheduled, completed, or cancelled appointments for a given provider.

Args:
    provider_id (str): Unique identifier of the healthcare provider.

Returns:
    dict:
        - success (True) and data: List[AppointmentInfo] (can be empty if no appointments)
        - success (False) and error: str, reason for failure (provider does not exist)

Constraints:
    - Provider must exist in the system.

function.name: check_appointment_conflict
function.description:
Determine if a patient or provider already has an appointment in a given time slot (prevent overlap).

Args:
    provider_id (str): Provider's unique ID to check for conflicts.
    patient_id (str): Patient's unique ID to check for conflicts.
    start_time (str): Start of time slot (ISO datetime string).
    end_time (str): End of time slot (ISO datetime string).

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": {
            "provider_conflict": bool,  # True if provider has overlapping appointment
            "provider_conflict_appointments": List[AppointmentInfo],  # Conflicting appts
            "patient_conflict": bool,   # True if patient has overlapping appointment
            "patient_conflict_appointments": List[AppointmentInfo],   # Conflicting appts
        }
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure
    }

Constraints:
    - Only scheduled appointments considered (not cancelled/completed).
    - Appointments overlap if scheduled_time falls within [start_time, end_time).
    - provider_id and patient_id must exist.
    - Input time strings must be comparable.

function.name: get_appointment_info
function.description:
Retrieve all details for a specific appointment by appointment_id.

Args:
    appointment_id (str): The unique identifier for the appointment to look up.

Returns:
    dict: 
        - On success: {"success": True, "data": AppointmentInfo}
        - On failure: {"success": False, "error": "Appointment not found"}

Constraints:
    - Appointment_id must exist in the system.

function.name: schedule_appointment
function.description:
Reserve a time slot and create an appointment between a patient and provider.

Args:
    patient_id (str): ID of the patient.
    provider_id (str): ID of the provider.
    start_time (str): ISO format start time of the appointment.
    end_time (str): ISO format end time of the appointment.
    appointment_type (str): Type of appointment (e.g., video, phone).
    appointment_id (str, optional): Unique ID to assign to the appointment. If None, auto-generate.

Returns:
    dict:
        success: True if appointment scheduled, False otherwise.
        message: Description on success.
        appointment_info: AppointmentInfo dict for new appointment (on success).
        error: Error message (on failure).

Constraints:
    - Patient and provider IDs must exist.
    - Time slot must exist and is unbooked.
    - Appointments cannot overlap for provider or patient.
    - Only available/unbooked time slots can be reserved.

function.name: cancel_appointment
function.description:
Cancels a telehealth appointment and marks the associated provider time slot as unbooked.

Args:
    appointment_id (str): The ID of the appointment to cancel.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Appointment <appointment_id> cancelled and time slot released."
    }
    or {
        "success": False,
        "error": str
    }

Constraints:
    - Appointment must exist.
    - Associated TimeSlot must be marked as unbooked if found.
    - Appointment status will be set to 'cancelled'.

function.name: complete_appointment
function.description:
Marks an appointment as completed after its telehealth session.

Args:
    appointment_id (str): The unique identifier of the appointment to complete.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Appointment <appointment_id> has been marked as completed."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "reason"
    }

Constraints:
    - The appointment_id must exist.
    - Appointment must not already be completed or cancelled.

function.name: update_appointment_status
function.description:
Change the appointment_status for a specified appointment to a given value.

Args:
    appointment_id (str): The unique identifier of the appointment to modify.
    new_status (str): The new status to set (e.g., 'scheduled', 'completed', 'cancelled', etc.).

Returns:
    dict: 
        - On success: { "success": True, "message": "Appointment status updated to <new_status>" }
        - On failure:
            { "success": False, "error": "Appointment not found" }
            { "success": False, "error": "Invalid status <new_status>" }

Constraints:
    - Only update status for existing appointment.
    - new_status should be one of: 'scheduled', 'completed', 'cancelled' (enforced for consistency).

function.name: release_timeslot
function.description:
Mark a booked time slot as available (typically after appointment cancellation).

Args:
    provider_id (str): ID of the provider whose time slot is to be released.
    start_time (str): ISO format string of the time slot's start.
    end_time (str): ISO format string of the time slot's end.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Time slot released and now available."
    }
    OR
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "reason for failure"
    }

Constraints:
    - The time slot must exist for the given provider and time.
    - Operation is idempotent: if the slot is already available, treat as a successful release.

function.name: reschedule_appointment
function.description:
Move a scheduled appointment to a different available time slot.

Args:
    appointment_id (str): The ID of the appointment to move.
    new_start_time (str): Desired start time (ISO datetime string) for the new slot.
    new_end_time (str): Desired end time (ISO datetime string) for the new slot.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Appointment rescheduled to <new_start_time>-<new_end_time>."
    }
    OR
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "reason"
    }

Constraints:
    - Appointment must exist and be in 'scheduled' status.
    - Only available, unbooked time slots can be reserved.
    - Provider/patient cannot have overlapping appointments.

bad_patterns: 在环境 env_142_rl中，schedule_appointment 跳过 check_appointment_conflict 和 get_timeslot_availability，医患双边撞号。
skills: 使用环境 env_142_rl时，get_provider_by_specialty → list_provider_available_time_slots → get_timeslot_availability。预约前 check_appointment_conflict（患者侧 get_patient_appointments）。成功后 get_appointment_info 确认；改期先 cancel_appointment 再约新槽，不要直接覆盖。

function.name: get_patient_by_name
function.description:
Retrieve patient details and patient_id(s) using the patient's name.

Args:
    name (str): The full name of the patient to search for.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[PatientInfo]  # List of patient infos matching the name
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason, e.g., no match
    }

Constraints:
    - If name is empty, operation fails (name must be specified).
    - If no patients match by name, operation fails.
    - Multiple patients with the same name are all returned.

function.name: get_patient_by_id
function.description:
Retrieve patient information for the given patient_id.

Args:
    patient_id (str): The unique identifier of the patient.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": PatientInfo  # Patient's complete information
    }
    OR
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # "Patient not found"
    }

Constraints:
    - The patient_id must exist in the system.

function.name: list_all_patients
function.description:
Returns all patient records currently present in the hospital system.

Args:
    None

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[PatientInfo],  # List of all patients' info (may be empty)
    }

Constraints:
    - None.

Edge cases:
    - If no patients exist in the system, 'data' will be an empty list.

function.name: get_department_by_name
function.description:
Retrieve the department's details using its name.

Args:
    name (str): The department's name to query.

Returns:
    dict:
        - On success:
            {
              "success": True,
              "data": DepartmentInfo  # Includes department_id, name, location
            }
        - On failure (not found):
            {
              "success": False,
              "error": "Department not found"
            }

Constraints:
    - Department names are assumed unique.

function.name: get_department_by_id
function.description:
Retrieve department information by its unique department_id.

Args:
    department_id (str): Unique identifier for the department.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": DepartmentInfo,  # Department data if found
    }
    OR
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure (e.g. 'Department not found')
    }

Constraints:
    - department_id must exist in the system.

function.name: list_departments
function.description:
List all hospital departments available in the system.

Args:
    None

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[DepartmentInfo],  # A list of all department info (may be empty if no departments)
    }
Constraints:
    - No input constraints. Returns all departments present in the system.

function.name: get_procedure_by_name
function.description:
Retrieve details (including procedure_id) for a procedure given its name.

Args:
    name (str): The name of the procedure to retrieve.

Returns:
    dict: 
        On success: {"success": True, "data": ProcedureInfo}
        On failure: {"success": False, "error": "Procedure not found"}

Constraints:
    - Exact name match is required.

function.name: get_procedure_by_id
function.description:
Retrieve procedure information by its unique procedure_id.

Args:
    procedure_id (str): The unique identifier for the procedure.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": ProcedureInfo
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # "Procedure not found"
    }

Constraints:
    - procedure_id must exist in the system.

function.name: list_procedures_for_department
function.description:
List all valid procedure types available for a specific department.

Args:
    department_id (str): The ID of the department for which to list procedures.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[ProcedureInfo],    # List may be empty if no procedures for the department
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str      # If department does not exist
    }

Constraints:
    - Department must exist.
    - Only list procedures that have been added/assigned to this department.

function.name: get_surgery_waitlist_entries_for_patient
function.description:
Retrieve all surgery waitlist entries (with metadata) for a given patient.

Args:
    patient_id (str): Unique identifier for the patient.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[SurgeryWaitlistEntryInfo],  # May be empty if patient has no entries
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Description (e.g. patient does not exist)
    }

Constraints:
    - Patient must exist in the system.

function.name: get_surgery_waitlist_entries_by_department_procedure
function.description:
Retrieve all waitlist entries for a given department and procedure.

Args:
    department_id (str): Identifier of the department.
    procedure_id (str): Identifier of the procedure.

Returns:
    dict: {

Args:

Returns:

        - success (bool): True if successful, False if failed.
        - message (str): Operation message if successful.
        - aggregated_rating (float or None): Updated average rating (None if no approved reviews).

    }

Constraints:
    - User id must exist in the platform.
    - Contact id must exist in contacts.
    - Returns all messages in the user-contact conversation(s).

function.name: get_message_delivery_status
send_message

function.name: create_conversation

Initiate a new conversation record between two users or a user and a contact,
if such a conversation does not already exist.

    user_id1 (str): The ID of the first user/participant.

Returns:

    }

    {
        'success': False,
        'error': str
    }

Constraints:
    - Both participants must exist (in users or contacts).
    - Conversation between same pair must be unique.
    - Participants must not be identical.

function.name: mark_message_as_read

function.name: delete_message

        "error": str  # Reason for failure
    }

function.name: delete_conversation

function.name: check_subscription_links
cancel_subscription
function.description:
Cancel an active subscription. Changes its status to 'cancelled' if currently 'active',
and halts future payments and scheduled shipments per related constraints.

Args:
    subscription_id (str): The subscription to cancel.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Subscription cancelled successfully"
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str
    }

Constraints:
    - Only subscriptions with status 'active' can be cancelled.
    - Canceling halts all future (pending/scheduled) payments and shipments.

function.name: invalidate_future_payments
function.description:
Mark future scheduled payments for a canceled subscription as invalid or halted.

Args:
    subscription_id (str): The identifier for the subscription whose future payments should be invalidated.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": str  # e.g. 'N future payments invalidated for subscription X.'
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Error reason (subscription not found, not canceled, etc.)
    }

Constraints:
    - Only permitted if the subscription exists and is NOT active.
    - Payments considered 'future scheduled' are those with a payment_date in the future, and payment_status not "completed" or already "invalid".

function.name: halt_scheduled_shipments
function.description:
Mark future scheduled shipments for a canceled subscription as halted or invalid.

Args:
    subscription_id (str): ID of the subscription.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": str  # Details of halt result
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str
    }

Constraints:
    - Only affects shipments linked to the subscription_id.
    - Marks as halted/invalid those that are scheduled for the future or are pending.
    - Subscription must exist.

function.name: update_payment_record
function.description:
Update the status or details of a payment record, typically when a subscription is canceled.
This may include refunding a payment, voiding a pending charge, or changing payment status.

Args:
    payment_id (str): The unique identifier of the payment to update.
    payment_status (str): The new status for the payment (e.g. 'refunded', 'void').
    amount (float, optional): If performing a refund, the refunded amount (must not exceed original).
    payment_date (str, optional): Date to set for status change.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Payment record updated successfully"
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str
    }

Constraints:
    - Payment must exist and be linked to a subscription.
    - For 'refunded' payments, refund amount must not exceed original payment.
    - Payments already refunded or voided cannot be updated further.
    - Only allowed status transitions will be performed.

function.name: update_shipment_record
function.description:
Update shipment record status/details, typically when a subscription is canceled or shipment is halted.

Args:
    shipment_id (str): Unique ID of the shipment.
    shipment_status (str): New status for the shipment (e.g. "canceled", "stopped", "delivered", "failed").
    shipment_date (str, optional): Updated shipment date (ISO format or other agreed format).
    tracking_num (str, optional): Updated shipment tracking number.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Shipment record updated successfully."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "Reason for failure"
    }

Constraints:
    - Shipment must exist for given shipment_id.
    - Shipment_status must be a valid value.
    - Other fields optionally updated if provided.

function.name: modify_subscription_details
function.description:
Edit attributes of a subscription (such as dates or recurrence pattern), for cancellation flow or user request.

Args:
    subscription_id (str): ID of subscription to modify.
    updates (dict): Dictionary of attribute-value pairs to update, keys must match SubscriptionInfo fields
                    (e.g., 'start_date', 'next_shipment_date', 'recurrence_pattern').

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Subscription <id> updated: <field1>, <field2>."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Error description
    }

Constraints:
    - Subscription must exist.
    - Only existing/updatable fields may be modified.
    - If no valid attributes provided, return error.

function.name: restore_cancelled_subscription
function.description:
Re-activate a previously cancelled subscription, if allowed by business rules.

Args:
    subscription_id (str): The identifier of the subscription to restore.

Returns:

        "success": True,
        "message": "Subscription re-activated."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Error reason.
    }

Constraints:
    - Only subscriptions with status 'cancelled' can be restored.
    - Subscription must exist and be linked to a valid user and product.

skills: 使用环境 env_148_rl时，先 get_user_by_id、list_user_subscriptions、check_subscription_links 确认订阅、付款和发货链条。取消顺序是 cancel_subscription → invalidate_future_payments → halt_scheduled_shipments，再用 get_subscription_status、get_payments_by_subscription_id、get_shipments_by_subscription_id 三边核对，缺一不可。

function.name: find_class_sessions
function.description:
Query class sessions by optional filters (class_type, date, start/end time, instructor, location).

Args:
    class_type (str, optional): Class type to filter.
    date (str, optional): Date string to filter (e.g., 'YYYY-MM-DD').
    start_time (str, optional): Session start time (e.g., 'HH:MM').
    end_time (str, optional): Session end time (e.g., 'HH:MM').
    instructor_id (str, optional): Instructor ID to filter.
    location_id (str, optional): Location ID to filter.

Returns:
    dict:
        - success (bool): True if query completed.
        - data (List[ClassSessionInfo]): List of matching sessions (may be empty).
        - error (str, optional): Present only if an error occurred.

function.name: get_class_session_details

                "error": "Class session not found",
            }

function.name: list_user_registrations

function.name: get_user_by_name

function.name: get_user_by_id
function.description:
Retrieve user information by user ID.

    }

function.name: get_instructor_by_id
function.description:
Retrieve instructor details by instructor_id.

function.name: list_instructor_sessions

function.name: get_location_by_id
function.description:
Retrieve location details by location_id.

function.name: check_class_capacity
check_user_schedule_conflict
function.description:
Check if a user's current class registrations conflict (overlap in time) with the given class session.

Args:
    user_id (str): The user to be checked.
    target_session_id (str): The session for proposed registration.

Returns:
    dict:
        success: True if query succeeded,
            data: bool (True if conflict exists, False otherwise),
            conflicting_sessions: List of session_ids that conflict.
        success: False with error message if user or session not found.

Constraints:
    - Only sessions registered by the user on the same date as the target are checked.
    - Time windows [start_time, end_time) are compared for overlap.
    - Session times are in "HH:MM" 24hr format.

function.name: check_registration_deadline
function.description:
Query whether registration or cancellation for a class session is still allowed, 
based on the session's start time and the current datetime.

Args:
    session_id (str): Identifier for the class session.
    current_datetime (str): Current date-time in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM).

Returns:
    dict: 
      {
        "success": True,
        "data": {
            "registration_allowed": bool,
            "cancellation_allowed": bool,
            "registration_deadline": str, # ISO format
            "cancellation_deadline": str  # ISO format
        }
      }
      or
      {
        "success": False,
        "error": str
      }

Constraints:
    - Registration or cancellation must occur before the cutoff deadline 
      (default: 1 hour before session's scheduled start).
    - The session_id must exist.
    - Datetime formats must be correct (ISO: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM').

function.name: register_user_for_session
function.description:
Registers a user for a given class session, enforcing constraints:
  - Class capacity cannot be exceeded.
  - User cannot register for overlapping classes.
  - Session must have assigned instructor and location.
  - User must not already be registered.

Args:
    user_id (str): User's unique ID.
    session_id (str): Target class session's unique ID.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "User registered for session successfully."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "Description of reason for failure."
    }

function.name: cancel_user_registration
function.description:
Remove a user's registration from a class session.

Args:
    user_id (str): The user's unique identifier.
    session_id (str): The class session's unique identifier.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "User registration cancelled successfully."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str
    }

Constraints:
    - Session and user must exist.
    - User must be registered in the session.
    - (Optional) Cancellation deadlines not implemented in this method.

function.name: modify_user_registration
function.description:
Change a user's registration from one class session to another, if allowed.

Args:
    user_id (str): The user whose registration should be changed.
    from_session_id (str): The session user is currently registered for (to drop).
    to_session_id (str): The target session to register for.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": Confirmation message
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": Error reason
    }

Constraints:
    - User must be registered for 'from_session_id'.
    - 'to_session_id' must exist and not be full.
    - User must not have other schedule conflicts (besides 'from_session_id').
    - Target session must have a valid instructor and location.

function.name: create_class_session
function.description:
Add a new class session to the system.

Args:
    session_id (str): Unique identifier for this class session.
    class_type (str): Type/name of the class.
    date (str): Date of the session (format assumed 'YYYY-MM-DD').
    start_time (str): Start time ('HH:MM').
    end_time (str): End time ('HH:MM').
    location_id (str): Location identifier where this session is held.
    instructor_id (str): Instructor assigned to this session.
    capacity (int): Maximum number of registrants allowed.

Returns:
    dict:
        - On success: {"success": True, "message": "Class session created successfully"}
        - On failure: {"success": False, "error": "<reason>"}

Constraints:
    - session_id must be unique and not already exist.
    - instructor_id must exist in instructors.
    - location_id must exist in locations.
    - capacity must be > 0.
    - registered_user_ids starts as empty list.

function.name: update_class_session_details
function.description:
Change details for an existing class session (date, time, location, instructor, capacity).

Args:
    session_id (str): Identifier for the class session to modify.
    date (str, optional): New date for the session.
    start_time (str, optional): New start time for the session.
    end_time (str, optional): New end time for the session.
    location_id (str, optional): New location ID for the session.
    instructor_id (str, optional): New instructor ID for the session.
    capacity (int, optional): New maximum capacity for the session.

Returns:
    dict:
        { "success": True, "message": "Class session details updated" }
        or
        { "success": False, "error": str }

Constraints:
    - Session must exist.
    - Updated location_id and instructor_id (if provided) must be valid.
    - Capacity cannot be set below current registrations.

function.name: assign_instructor_to_session
function.description:
Assign or change the instructor for a class session.

Args:
    session_id (str): Target class session identifier.
    instructor_id (str): Instructor identifier to assign.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Instructor assigned to class session."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure (session or instructor does not exist)
    }

Constraints:
    - The class session and instructor must exist.
    - Updates instructor_id for ClassSessionInfo.
    - Updates assigned_class_session_ids for both previous and new instructor.

function.name: assign_location_to_session
function.description:
Assign or change the location for a specified class session.

Args:
    session_id (str): The ID of the class session to update.
    location_id (str): The ID of the location to assign.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Location assigned to session successfully."
    }
    or

        "success": False,
        "error": "Session or location does not exist."
    }

Constraints:
    - Session ID must exist.
    - Location ID must exist.

function.name: update_session_capacity
function.description:
Change the class session’s maximum allowed registered users.

Args:
    session_id (str): Identifier of the class session to update.
    new_capacity (int): The new maximum allowed registered users.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Class session capacity updated."
    }
    OR
    dict: {
        "success": False,
        "error": "reason"
    }

Constraints:
    - session_id must refer to an existing session.
    - new_capacity must be a positive integer.
    - new_capacity must be >= current number of registered users in the session.

function.name: delete_class_session
function.description:
Permanently remove a class session from the schedule (admin-level).

Args:
    session_id (str): The unique identifier of the class session to delete.

Returns:
    dict:
        Success: { "success": True, "message": "Class session <session_id> deleted." }
        Failure: { "success": False, "error": "reason" }

Constraints:
    - The session_id must exist.
    - All user registration histories and instructor session assignments
      referencing this session must be cleaned (session_id removed).

bad_patterns: 在环境 env_149_rl中，忽略 check_class_capacity、check_user_schedule_conflict 和 check_registration_deadline，直接 register_user_for_session，造成超员或同一学员双课。
skills: 使用环境 env_149_rl时，用 find_class_sessions / get_class_session_details 锁定课次，list_user_registrations 看已报名记录。报名前进 check_class_capacity、check_user_schedule_conflict、check_registration_deadline；成功后再 get_class_session_details 确认人数。冲突时改选其他 session，不要覆盖别人的名额。

- If prescription_required, a valid prescription must be on file.

- Order starts with status 'created' and payment_status 'pending'.

function.name: reserve_medication_inventory
function.description:
Decrement medication inventory by the reserved quantity for an order.

Args:
    medication_id (str): The ID of the medication to reserve.
    quantity (int): Number of units to reserve (must be positive).

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Reserved <quantity> units of medication_id <medication_id>."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure, e.g., not enough stock, invalid medication, bad input
    }

Constraints:
    - Medication must exist in the catalog.
    - Quantity must be positive.
    - quantity_in_stock >= quantity.

function.name: validate_prescription_for_order
function.description:
Processes and marks a prescription as validated for an order item.

Args:
    order_id (str): The ID of the order containing the medication.
    medication_id (str): The medication ID to validate prescription for.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Prescription validated for order item"
    }
    or
    dict: {
        "success": False,
        "error": "Reason for failure"
    }

Constraints:
    - Order must exist.
    - Order item for medication_id must exist in order.
    - Medication must require a prescription.
    - User must have a valid prescription for this medication.
    - If already validated, return success.

function.name: mark_order_as_paid
function.description:
Updates the payment_status of the specified order to "paid".

Args:
    order_id (str): The unique identifier for the order.

Returns:
    dict:
        success (bool): True if update succeeds, False otherwise.
        message (str): Success message on payment marked as paid.
        error (str): Present if operation fails (e.g., order not found).

Constraints:
    - order_id must exist.
    - Does not update cancelled orders ("status" == "cancelled").

function.name: update_order_fulfillment_status
function.description:
Update the fulfillment status of an order.

Args:
    order_id (str): The ID of the order to update.
    new_status (str): The new status to set (e.g., "preparing", "shipped", "delivered").

Returns:
    dict: 
      - On success: { "success": True, "message": "Order status updated to <new_status>" }
      - On failure: { "success": False, "error": str }

Constraints:
    - Order must exist.
    - Orders may not be fulfilled (i.e., status beyond 'pending' or pre-payment) until payment_status is 'paid'.
    - Status must be a valid string.

function.name: update_delivery_details
function.description:
Assign shipping/tracking info to an order after it has been fulfilled.

Args:
    order_id (str): The order to update.
    fulfillment_details (str): The shipping or tracking information to assign.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Delivery details updated for order <order_id>."
    }
    or {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Description of the error
    }

Constraints:
- The order must exist.
- The order's status must be 'fulfilled' or equivalent before details can be assigned.
- Does not update if order not fulfilled.

function.name: cancel_order
function.description:
Cancel an existing order. If permitted, restores medication inventory by 
incrementing the quantities for the ordered items.

Args:
    order_id (str): The unique identifier of the order to cancel.

Returns:
    dict: 
        - On success: {
            "success": True,
            "message": "Order <order_id> cancelled and inventory restored."
        }
        - On failure: {
            "success": False,
            "error": "reason"
        }

Constraints:
    - Order must exist.
    - Order may only be cancelled if its status is not 'fulfilled', 'shipped', 'delivered', or 'cancelled'.
    - Inventory restoration only happens at cancellation.

function.name: modify_order_item
function.description:
Adjust medication, dosage, or quantity of an order item prior to order fulfillment.

Args:
    order_id (str): ID of the order containing the item to modify.
    order_item_idx (int): Index within the order's order_items list (0-based).
    medication_id (str, optional): New medication_id to set (if changing medication).
    dosage (str, optional): New dosage to set (if changing dosage).
    quantity (int, optional): New quantity (if changing quantity).

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Order item updated for order <order_id>."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "Reason for failure."
    }

Constraints:
    - May only modify items for orders that are not yet fulfilled/cancelled/completed.
    - The medication_id and dosage must exist in catalog and match.
    - Quantity must not exceed available stock.
    - Index must be valid in order_items list.

function.name: add_address_to_user
function.description:
Save a new shipping address to a user's profile.

Args:
    user_id (str): ID of the user to add the address to.
    address_info (dict): Includes street, city, state, zip_code, country.

Returns:
    dict: 
        {
            "success": True,
            "message": "Address added successfully"
        }
        or
        {
            "success": False,
            "error": "<reason>"
        }

Constraints:
    - The user_id must exist.
    - The address must include all required fields: street, city, state, zip_code, country.
    - Address must not already exist for the user (same street/city/state/zip/country).
    - The newly created address object is stored in self.addresses and address_id added to user's saved_addresses.

function.name: remove_address_from_user
function.description:
Removes a shipping address from a user’s profile, if it is associated.

Args:
    user_id (str): The user ID.
    address_id (str): The address ID to remove.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Address removed from user profile"
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # explanation of the failure reason
    }

Constraints:
    - User must exist.
    - Address must exist.
    - Address must belong to user.
    - Address must be present in user's saved_addresses.

bad_patterns: 在环境 env_150_rl中，处方药未 is_prescription_validated 就预占库存，或改数量后不补 reserve。
skills: 使用环境 env_150_rl时，get_medication_by_name_and_dosage → is_prescription_required；处方药走 get_prescription_record 与 is_prescription_validated，OTC 才直接 check_medication_inventory。地址用 get_saved_addresses_for_user / validate_address_for_user。改数量后重新预占，get_order_status 确认 paid/shipped 与库存一致。

function.name: get_user_account_by_username
function.description:
Retrieve a user account's information by username.

Args:
    username (str): The unique username to search for.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": UserAccountInfo,  # User account info dict
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason not found
    }

Constraints:
    - If multiple accounts share the same username (should not happen), returns the first match found.
    - Returns error if username not found.

function.name: get_participant_by_user_account
function.description:
Given an account_id or username, retrieve the matching participant info.

Args:
    account_id (str, optional): Account ID of the user.
    username (str, optional): Username of the user account.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": ParticipantInfo,
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str,  # Reason for failure.
    }

Constraints:
    - At least one identifier (account_id or username) must be provided.
    - The user account must exist and reference a valid participant.

function.name: get_participant_by_id
function.description:
Retrieve participant info using participant_id.

Args:
    participant_id (str): The unique identifier for the participant.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": ParticipantInfo
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason why lookup failed.
    }

Constraints:
    - The participant_id must exist in the system.

function.name: list_enrollments_for_participant
function.description:
List all enrollment records for a given participant.

Args:
    participant_id (str): Unique identifier of the participant.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[EnrollmentInfo],  # List of enrollment records for the participant (may be empty)
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Error message if participant does not exist
    }

Constraints:
    - The participant_id must exist in the system.
    - All enrollment records for the given participant are returned.

function.name: list_current_enrollments_for_participant
function.description:
Lists all enrollment records for a participant where the enrollment_status is "enrolled".

Args:
    participant_id (str): Unique identifier of the participant.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[EnrollmentInfo],  # List may be empty if no current enrollments
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # If participant_id is invalid
    }

Constraints:
    - The participant_id must exist in the system.
    - Only enrollments with enrollment_status "enrolled" are returned.

function.name: get_clinical_trial_by_id
function.description:
Retrieve detailed information for a clinical trial given its trial_id.

Args:
    trial_id (str): The unique ID for the clinical trial.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": ClinicalTrialInfo  # Information about the clinical trial
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure (e.g., not found)
    }

Constraints:
    - trial_id must correspond to an existing clinical trial.

function.name: list_clinical_trials_for_enrollments
function.description:
Given a list of enrollment records, fetch detailed trial information for each enrolled trial.

Args:
    enrollments (list): List of EnrollmentInfo dicts.
                        Each should contain 'trial_id'.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[ClinicalTrialInfo]  # List containing trial info for each enrollment.
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Error message if input is invalid
    }

Constraints:
    - Each enrollment must reference a valid clinical trial.
    - Invalid or missing trial references are ignored.

function.name: get_enrollment_status
update_enrollment_status
function.description:
Change the status of a participant's enrollment.

Args:
    enrollment_id (str): The unique ID of the enrollment to update.
    new_status (str): The new status value ('enrolled', 'withdrawn', or 'completed').
    requesting_user_account_id (str, optional): If supplied, only allow modification
        if this user owns the enrollment (access control).

Returns:
    dict:
        On success:
            { "success": True, "message": "Enrollment status updated successfully." }
        On failure:
            { "success": False, "error": <reason> }

Constraints:
    - enrollment_id must exist and reference valid participant and clinical trial.
    - new_status must be one of: "enrolled", "withdrawn", "completed".
    - If requesting_user_account_id is provided, only allow change if user owns the enrollment.

function.name: enroll_participant_in_trial
function.description:
Create a new enrollment for a participant in a clinical trial, if consent_status is valid.

Args:
    participant_id (str): ID of the participant to enroll.
    trial_id (str): ID of the clinical trial to enroll into.
    enrollment_date (str, optional): Date of enrollment (if not provided, uses today).

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Participant enrolled in trial.",
        "enrollment_id": str  # The new enrollment's ID
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Explanation of failure (missing participant, invalid consent, etc.)
    }

Constraints:
    - Only participants with valid consent_status ("valid") may be enrolled.
    - Each enrollment must reference valid participant and clinical trial.
    - Enrollment_status = "enrolled" at creation.

function.name: update_participant_consent_status
function.description:
Change a participant's consent status (e.g., revoking or granting consent).

Args:
    participant_id (str): The participant to be updated.
    new_consent_status (str): The updated consent status (should be a non-empty string).

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Consent status for participant <participant_id> updated to <new_consent_status>."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Error description
    }

Constraints:
    - The participant must exist.
    - new_consent_status should be a non-empty string (more restrictions can be added if system supported values are enumerated).

function.name: withdraw_participant_from_trial
function.description:
Mark an enrollment record as "withdrawn" for the specified participant and clinical trial.

Args:
    participant_id (str): The participant's unique identifier.
    trial_id (str): The clinical trial's unique identifier.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Participant has been marked as withdrawn from the trial."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": <str>  # Reason for failure.
    }

Constraints:
    - Enrollment must exist for the specified participant and trial.
    - Enrollment must reference valid participant/trial.
    - Withdrawal possible only if not already withdrawn/completed.
    - Status must be set to "withdrawn".

function.name: create_user_account
function.description:
Register a new user account linked to a participant profile.

Args:
    username (str): Desired username for login.
    hashed_password (str): Securely hashed password string.
    participant_id (str): ID of participant to link this account to.
    account_status (str): Initial account status (e.g., 'active', 'pending', etc.).

Returns:
    dict: 
        - On success: {
              "success": True, 
              "message": "User account created",
              "account_id": str
          }
        - On failure: {
              "success": False,
              "error": str
          }

Constraints:
    - Username must be unique among all user accounts.
    - Participant_id must exist in participants.
    - Each participant can be linked to only one user account.

function.name: delete_enrollment
function.description:
Remove an enrollment record by its enrollment ID (admin action).

Args:
    enrollment_id (str): The ID of the enrollment to be deleted.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Enrollment <enrollment_id> deleted successfully."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": <error message>
    }

Constraints:
    - The enrollment must exist before deletion.
    - (Referential integrity: Enrollment is a link; no further cleanup required.)

function.name: update_clinical_trial_status
function.description:
Change the status of a clinical trial (e.g., 'active', 'completed', 'suspended').

Args:
    trial_id (str): The unique identifier of the clinical trial to update.
    new_status (str): The new status to set for the clinical trial.

Returns:
    dict: On success:
        { "success": True, "message": "Clinical trial status updated to <new_status>." }
    On error:
        { "success": False, "error": "<reason>" }

Constraints:
    - trial_id must reference an existing clinical trial.
    - new_status must be one of allowed status values: ["active", "completed", "suspended"]

bad_patterns: 在环境 env_151_rl中，未核对 list_current_enrollments_for_participant 和知情同意状态就 enroll_participant_in_trial，或把 withdraw 当成 update_enrollment_status 的普通流转。
skills: 使用环境 env_151_rl时，由 get_user_account_by_username → get_participant_by_user_account 定位受试者，再用 list_current_enrollments_for_participant 和 get_clinical_trial_by_id 排除重复入组。入组前 update_participant_consent_status；退出必须走 withdraw_participant_from_trial 而不是只改状态。每步用 get_enrollment_status 回读。

function.name: list_available_rooms

function.name: list_available_rooms_by_type

Constraints:

function.name: get_room_info

function.name: get_room_amenities

function.name: list_bookings_by_guest

function.name: get_booking_info

function.name: check_room_availability_over_date_range

Reserve a room for a guest over valid dates (with no overlaps) and update the room status to 'reserved'.

function.name: get_license_status
get_license_expiration_date
function.description:
Query the expiration date of a license.

Args:
    license_id (str): The unique identifier of the license.

Returns:
    dict: 
        On success:
        {
            "success": True,
            "data": str  # The expiration date in string format (ISO or YYYY-MM-DD)
        }
        On failure (e.g. license not found):
        {
            "success": False,
            "error": str  # Reason for failure
        }

Constraints:
    - None for query; license_id must exist.

function.name: get_license_actions
function.description:
List all historical disciplinary or compliance actions (e.g., suspensions, reinstatements)
for a given license.

Args:
    license_id (str): The unique ID of the license whose actions are to be retrieved.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[LicenseActionInfo],  # List of actions, may be empty.
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure, e.g., License not found.
    }

Constraints:
    - license_id must exist in the system.

function.name: check_license_validity
function.description:
Verify if a license is valid (status is 'active' and expiration_date >= current_date).

Args:
    license_id (str): The unique identifier for the license.
    current_date (str): The date to check validity against, in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": {
            "license_id": str,
            "status": str,
            "expiration_date": str,
            "is_valid": bool
        }
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # reason for failure: invalid license, wrong date format, etc.
    }

Constraints:
    - License must exist.
    - License is valid only if status == 'active' and expiration_date >= current_date.
    - Assumes ISO date format ('YYYY-MM-DD') for date comparison.

function.name: update_license_status
function.description:
Change the status of a license (e.g., suspend, revoke, reinstate) and record the action.

Args:
    license_id (str): The ID of the license to modify.
    new_status (str): The status to set ("active", "expired", "suspended", "revoked").
    action_type (str, optional): Type of action (default: "status change").
    action_description (str, optional): Details/reason for the status change.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Status updated and action recorded."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str
    }

Constraints:
    - License must exist.
    - Status must be one of the allowed values ("active", "expired", "suspended", "revoked").
    - Every status change is recorded as a LicenseAction.

function.name: record_license_action
function.description:
Log a new action/event to the license's historical actions.

Args:
    license_id (str): Unique identifier for the license to which the action applies.
    action_type (str): Type of action (e.g., suspension, notification, reinstatement).
    action_date (str): ISO date string when the action occurred.
    action_description (str): Brief details or explanation about the action.

Returns:
    dict:
      - On success: { "success": True, "message": "Action recorded for license <license_id>" }
      - On failure: { "success": False, "error": <reason> }

Constraints:
    - license_id must exist in self.licenses.
    - All input fields must be non-empty strings.
    - Action is appended to self.license_actions for that license_id.

function.name: update_license_expiration_date
function.description:
Modify the expiration date for a license.

Args:
    license_id (str): Unique identifier of the license to update.
    new_expiration_date (str): New expiration date value (format: "YYYY-MM-DD").

Returns:
    dict:
        On success: {
            "success": True,
            "message": "License expiration date updated successfully."
        }
        On error: {
            "success": False,
            "error": "License not found."
        }

Constraints:
    - license_id must exist.
    - Upon update, a LicenseAction should be recorded.

function.name: add_license_for_provider
function.description:
Issue a new license to a provider (add new license record).

Args:
    provider_id (str): The provider's unique ID.
    license_number (str): The license identifier in its jurisdiction.
    state (str): State in which license is issued.
    status (str): One of "active", "expired", "suspended", "revoked".
    issuance_date (str): Date license was issued (ISO format).
    expiration_date (str): Date license expires (ISO format).
    profession (str): Professional category covered by license.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "License issued to provider_id",
        "license_id": license_id
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure
    }

Constraints:
    - Provider must exist.
    - License (license_number, state, profession) must not duplicate any existing license.
    - Status must be one of allowed values.

function.name: delete_license
function.description:
Remove a license from the system, including any associated license actions.

Args:
    license_id (str): The unique ID of the license to delete.

Returns:
    dict: 
        {"success": True, "message": "License <license_id> deleted successfully."}
        OR
        {"success": False, "error": "License not found"}

Constraints:
    - License must exist.
    - Associated LicenseActions for this license_id are also removed.

function.name: update_provider_info
function.description:
Edit demographic or contact info for a provider.

Args:
    provider_id (str): Unique identifier of the provider to update.
    name (str, optional): New name (if updating).
    date_of_birth (str, optional): New date of birth (if updating).
    profession (str, optional): New profession (if updating).
    contact_information (str, optional): New contact information (if updating).

Returns:
    dict:
      - success: True and message on success.
      - success: False and error string if provider does not exist

Constraints:
    - provider_id must exist in the system.
    - Only the provided fields are updated. Others left unchanged.
    - At least one updatable field must be provided.

bad_patterns: 在环境 env_157_rl中，未 get_license_by_number_state_profession 查重就发新证，或忽略 check_license_validity 把过期证当有效。
skills: 使用环境 env_157_rl时，get_provider_by_name 落到 id，发证前 get_license_by_number_state_profession 保证州+职业+证号唯一。操作写入 get_license_actions；对外有效性只看 check_license_validity / get_valid_licenses_for_provider_in_state，不要用签发日推断未过期。

function.name: get_user_by_id
function.description:
Retrieve user account details using the user's _id.

Args:
    _id (str): The unique user ID to look up.

Returns:
    dict:

            "data": UserInfo  # Info dict for the user
        }
        On failure: {
            "success": False,
            "error": str  # Reason (e.g., "User not found")
        }

Constraints:
    - The _id must correspond to an existing user.

function.name: check_user_account_status
function.description:
Query the current status of a user's account.

Args:
    user_id (str): Unique user ID to look up.

Returns:
    dict:
        - If success:
            {
                "success": True,
                "data": {
                    "_id": user_id,
                    "account_status": str
                }
            }
        - If failure (user not found):
            {
                "success": False,
                "error": "User not found"
            }
Constraints:
    - Only exposes the queried user's information.
    - Valid user ID required.

function.name: list_sleep_logs_by_user
function.description:
Retrieve all sleep logs associated with the specified user_id.

Args:
    user_id (str): The user ID whose sleep logs are to be retrieved.
    requesting_user_id (str, optional): The user making the request.
        If provided, only allow access if requesting_user_id == user_id (privacy constraint).

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[SleepLogInfo],  # All sleep logs for user_id (empty if none)
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Description of the error (user not found, permission denied, etc.)
    }

Constraints:
    - user_id must exist.
    - User privacy: only allow user to view their own logs (if requesting_user_id given).

function.name: list_sleep_logs_by_user_and_time_range
function.description:
Retrieves all sleep logs for the specified user within a given start/end time period.

Args:
    user_id (str): The user whose sleep logs are queried.
    start_time (float): Start of the time window (epoch seconds, inclusive).
    end_time (float): End of the time window (epoch seconds, inclusive).
    requester_id (str): The user requesting the data. Must match user_id.

Returns:
    dict:
        On success:
            {"success": True, "data": List[SleepLogInfo]}
        On error:
            {"success": False, "error": str}

Constraints:
    - Both user_id and requester_id must exist.
    - Only self-access is allowed (requester_id == user_id).
    - start_time <= end_time

function.name: get_sleep_log_by_id
function.description:
Retrieve a specific sleep log by its log_id, if and only if the requesting
user (user_id) owns the log. Enforces user privacy.

Args:
    log_id (str): The unique ID of the sleep log.
    user_id (str): The ID of the user requesting the log.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": SleepLogInfo
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason: "User not found", "Sleep log not found", "Access denied"
    }

Constraints:
    - Must check that user_id exists.
    - Only allow access if sleep log's user_id matches requester's user_id.

function.name: aggregate_sleep_data_for_user
function.description:
Computes summary statistics over a user's sleep logs:
    - Total sleep duration (sum)
    - Average sleep quality (mode of 'sleep_quality' strings)
    - Count of sleep logs

Args:
    user_id (str): The user ID whose sleep data should be aggregated.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": {
            "total_duration": float,
            "average_quality": str,  # Most common sleep_quality value, or '' if none
            "count": int
        }
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str
    }

Constraints:
    - Only logs associated with existing user are included.
    - Duration must be non-negative.

function.name: generate_sleep_report_for_user
function.description:
Produce a formatted report (table, summary, visualization-ready) of a user's sleep data for a specified period.

Args:
    user_id (str): The target user whose report is requested.
    requesting_user_id (str): The user making the request (must be same as user_id for privacy).
    start_time (float, optional): Earliest sleep_start_time to include.
    end_time (float, optional): Latest sleep_end_time to include.

Returns:
    dict:
        If success: {
            "success": True,
            "data": {
                "logs": List[SleepLogInfo],           # List of matching sleep logs
                "summary": {
                    "total_nights": int,
                    "total_duration": float,            # total hours slept
                    "average_duration": float,          # avg hours/night
                    "average_quality": str              # avg sleep quality label
                }
            }
        }
        If error: {
            "success": False,
            "error": str  # Reason for failure
        }

Constraints:
    - Data privacy: only the user can access their own report.
    - User must exist.
    - start_time and end_time, if provided, must be valid chronology.

function.name: add_sleep_log
function.description:
Create a new sleep log entry for a given user, enforcing timestamp validity and user existence.

Args:
    log_id (str): Unique identifier for the sleep log.
    user_id (str): Identifier of the user associated with this log.
    sleep_start_time (float): When sleep started (epoch seconds).
    sleep_end_time (float): When sleep ended (epoch seconds).
    sleep_quality (str): User's assessment of sleep quality.

Returns:
    dict:
        success (bool): True if log added, False if error.
        message (str): Success message if applicable.
        error (str): On failure only, description of error.

Constraints:
    - user_id must exist
    - log_id must be unique
    - sleep_end_time >= sleep_start_time
    - duration (sleep_end_time - sleep_start_time) >= 0

function.name: update_sleep_log
function.description:
Modify details of a sleep log, with validation constraints:
  - Only the owner of the log (user_id) can update it.
  - If updating sleep_start_time or sleep_end_time, duration is recalculated and must be non-negative.
  - All times must be valid.
  - Only permitted fields can be updated.

Args:
    log_id (str): The ID of the sleep log to update.
    user_id (str): The user performing the update (privacy enforcement).
    sleep_start_time (float, optional): New sleep start time (epoch seconds).
    sleep_end_time (float, optional): New sleep end time (epoch seconds).
    sleep_quality (str, optional): New sleep quality value.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Sleep log updated successfully."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "reason"
    }

function.name: delete_sleep_log
function.description:
Remove an existing sleep log for a user.

Args:
    log_id (str): Unique identifier of the sleep log to delete.
    requesting_user_id (str): User ID of the user requesting deletion
                              (privacy enforcement).

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Sleep log <log_id> deleted for user <user_id>."
    }
    or {
        "success": False,
        "error": "<reason>"
    }

Constraints:
    - The sleep log must exist.
    - Only the user who owns the sleep log can delete it (privacy protected).

function.name: update_user_account_status
function.description:
Change a user's account status.

Args:
    user_id (str): The unique identifier of the user to update.
    new_status (str): The new account status to assign (e.g., 'active', 'suspended', 'closed').

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": str  # Confirmation of update
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Error description, e.g. "User not found."
    }

Constraints:
    - user_id must refer to an existing user.
    - Account status can be any non-empty string.

function.name: correct_sleep_log_duration
function.description:
Adjust a sleep log's duration field if inconsistent with start/end times.

Args:
    log_id (str): The unique log ID of the SleepLog to correct.

Returns:
    dict:
        - On success: {"success": True, "message": "Sleep log duration updated successfully."}
          (whether or not the duration needed correction)
        - On error: {"success": False, "error": "SleepLog not found" or "Invalid timestamps"}

Constraints:
    - The SleepLog must exist.
    - sleep_end_time must be >= sleep_start_time.
    - Duration will be set to (sleep_end_time - sleep_start_time).

bad_patterns: 在环境 env_158_rl中，add_sleep_log 时长与起止矛盾，却未 correct_sleep_log_duration，报告被异常值拉偏。
skills: 使用环境 env_158_rl时，check_user_account_status 后按时间窗 list_sleep_logs_by_user_and_time_range。写入后若时长不对必须 correct_sleep_log_duration；汇总用 aggregate_sleep_data_for_user / generate_sleep_report_for_user，不要把起床时间早于入睡的记录算进均值。

function.name: list_classes_by_datetime
function.description:
Retrieve all yoga classes scheduled for the specified date and time window.

Args:
    date (str): Target date in "YYYY-MM-DD" format.
    start_time (str): Start time of window in "HH:MM" (24-hour) format.

Returns:

        data (List[ClassInfo]): List of all matching classes (may be empty).
        error (str): Optional error message in case of failure.

Constraints:
    - Returns all classes whose date matches the input date, and where
      class start_time >= window start_time and class end_time <= window end_time.
    - If any argument missing or time format clearly invalid, returns error.

function.name: filter_classes_by_status

Return all classes filtered by their current status.

Args:
    status (str): Desired status to filter classes by (e.g., "active", "canceled").

Returns:
    dict: {

        "data": List[ClassInfo]  # List of classes where class['status'] == status
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Description of error, e.g. invalid status input
    }

Constraints:
    - status must be a non-empty string.

function.name: get_class_details
function.description:
Get full information about a specific class, including location, instructor, times, status, and capacity.

Constraints:

function.name: check_class_availability

Check if the specified class is available for booking.

Returns:
    dict: {

Constraints:
    - Class must exist.

function.name: get_instructor_details
function.description:
Retrieve information about the instructor for a specific class.

Returns:

function.name: get_user_by_id

Get user information for a given user_id.

function.name: check_user_account_status
function.description:
Query the account status (active/disabled) for a user.

function.name: list_enrollments_for_class

function.name: list_user_enrollments

function.name: create_enrollment

function.name: cancel_enrollment
function.description:
Cancel an existing enrollment (set status to 'canceled').

Args:
    enrollment_id (str): The unique identifier for the enrollment to cancel.

Returns:
    dict:

        message (str): Success info if canceled.

Constraints:
    - Enrollment_id must exist.
    - If already canceled, return success but with appropriate message.

function.name: update_enrollment_status

Change the status of a specific enrollment (e.g., "booked" to "canceled").

Args:
    enrollment_id (str): Unique identifier for the enrollment.
    new_status (str): New status to set ("booked", "canceled").

Returns:
    dict:

        On failure: { "success": False, "error": str }

Constraints:
    - Enrollment must exist in the system.
    - Status must be a valid value ("booked", "canceled").

function.name: update_class_status

Change the status of the specified class (e.g., mark as 'canceled' or 'active').

Args:
    class_id (str): Unique identifier of the class to update.

Returns:
    dict: {

        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Description of reason (class not found, invalid status)

function.name: modify_class_details

Update details of a specified yoga class.

function.name: modify_enrollment_details

Change information for a specific enrollment: user and/or class association.

Args:
