    new_class_id (str, optional): New class to associate (if given).

Returns:

        - Failure: { "success": False, "error": <reason> }

function.name: get_user_profile_by_name

Retrieve the full user profile data by user name.

Returns:

function.name: list_all_user_profiles
function.description:

function.name: add_payment_to_bill

Register a new payment to a bill, ensuring the total paid does not exceed amount_due.

function.name: update_bill_status

function.name: create_outbreak_report
function.description:
Submit a new outbreak report for a given disease/location/reporter.

Args:
    disease_name (str): The disease to report.
    location_id (str): The geographical location ID of the outbreak.
    date_reported (str): Date of report (ISO format preferred).
    reporter_id (str): ID of the submitting reporter.
    case_count (int): Number of cases reported (must be >=1).

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Report submitted with id <report_id>"
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "reason for failure"
    }

Constraints:
    - Disease must exist and be notifiable/recognized.
    - Location must exist.
    - Reporter must exist.
    - Case count must be a positive integer.
    - Each report must link valid disease, location, and reporter.
    - Status workflow begins as "submitted".
    - Verification state starts as "unverified".

function.name: verify_outbreak_report
function.description:
Change the status of the specified outbreak report to "verified" after review/confirmation.

Args:
    report_id (str): The ID of the outbreak report to verify.

Returns:
    dict:
        - On success:
            {"success": True, "message": "Report <report_id> successfully verified."}
        - On failure:
            {"success": False, "error": "reason"}

Constraints:
    - The report must exist.
    - Status transition: only reports in "submitted" status can be verified.
    - Disease must be recognized/notifiable.
    - Reporter credentials must be present (and not blank).

function.name: escalate_outbreak_report
function.description:
Change the status of the specified outbreak report to "escalated," and 'notify' higher authorities.
Performs appropriate constraint checking:
  - Report must exist.
  - Disease must be recognized and notifiable.
  - Report must not already be escalated or closed.
  - Report status transition must follow workflow (e.g., should be "verified" or "submitted").
  - Reporter identity and credentials must be validated.
  - Report must be linked to a defined location.

Args:
    report_id (str): The ID of the outbreak report to escalate.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": str
    }
    or
    dict: {
        "success": False,
        "error": str
    }

function.name: close_outbreak_report
function.description:
Change the status of the specified outbreak report to "closed".
Indicates case resolution or invalidation.

Args:
    report_id (str): Unique identifier of the outbreak report.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Report <report_id> closed."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": <reason>
    }

Constraints:
    - The report_id must exist.
    - Report must not already be closed.
    - Status workflow: typical statuses are "submitted" → "verified" → "escalated"/"closed". Closing is only allowed unless already closed. (Can implement additional workflow rules here.)

    }
    or

        "error": str
    }

Constraints:
    - Session must exist.
    - User must exist.

function.name: add_participant_to_session
function.description:
Add a new participant (user) to an existing session.

Args:

    user_id (str): The ID of the user to add.

Returns:

Constraints:

    - User must exist.
    - User must not already be a participant in the session.

function.name: remove_participant_from_session
function.description:
Remove a participant (by user_id) from a conference session.

Args:
    session_id (str): Target session from which to remove the participant.
    user_id (str): User ID of the participant to be removed.

Returns:

        "message": "Participant <user_id> removed from session <session_id>."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure (e.g., session/participant not found, constraint violation)
    }

Constraints:
    - Session must exist.
    - User must be a participant in the session.
    - After removal, the session must still have at least one participant.

function.name: update_participant_role
function.description:
Change the role of a participant in a given session.

Args:
    session_id (str): Session identifier.
    user_id (str): User identifier.
    new_role (str): New role to assign to the participant (e.g., 'host', 'attendee').

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": str  # Confirmation of successful update
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Description of the error
    }

Constraints:
    - The session must exist.
    - The participant must be associated with the session.
    - Role is updated for the specified user in the specified session.

function.name: change_session_status
function.description:
Set the status of a session to a new valid value.

Args:

    new_status (str): One of {'scheduled', 'in progress', 'completed', 'canceled'}.

Returns:

Constraints:
    - session_id must exist.
    - new_status must be a valid status.

bad_patterns: 在环境 env_164_rl中，edit_session_time 未检查 is_user_authorized_for_session，或 add_participant_to_session 加了未注册用户。
skills: 使用环境 env_164_rl时，get_session_by_id 看主办方，is_user_authorized_for_session 通过才能 cancel/edit。参会者必须先 get_user_by_email 再 add_participant_to_session；改时后 list_upcoming_sessions_by_user 与 get_session_participants 确认，避免幽灵参会人。

function.name: list_all_manufacturers

function.name: get_manufacturer_by_name

function.name: list_all_locations

function.name: get_location_by_name

function.name: is_device_id_unique

function.name: list_all_devices

function.name: register_new_device

function.name: create_maintenance_schedule

function.name: update_device_status

function.name: create_new_location
function.description:

function.name: update_maintenance_compliance_status
function.description:
Change or certify the compliance status of a device's maintenance schedule.

function.name: get_appointment_by_id

function.name: add_dispute_resolution_details
function.description:
Attach or update the resolution_details text field in the given dispute record.

function.name: add_dispute

function.name: delete_dispute

function.name: assign_dispute_resolver

function.name: timestamp_dispute_resolution

Record or update the resolution_date field of a dispute when its resolution status changes.

bad_patterns: 在环境 env_169_rl中，只改了 dispute 的 resolution_status，没有用 get_dispute_by_billing_item_id 和 validate_dispute_billing_item_relation 核对账单条目，也没有写入 get_dispute_resolution_history 所需的处理说明，用户看到的结案状态和环境里的账单余额对不上。
skills: 使用环境 env_169_rl时，先 get_billing_item_by_id 拿到争议账单，再用 get_dispute_by_billing_item_id / list_disputes_by_status 定位纠纷；resolve_dispute 前用 get_allowed_resolution_status_values 和 get_operator_by_id 确认操作员权限与合法状态机。结案后必须 add_dispute_resolution_details，并用 get_dispute_resolution_history 回读，不要只回报“已处理”。

function.name: get_user_by_id

function.name: list_active_user_medications

function.name: get_medication_by_id

function.name: check_medication_existence

function.name: get_medication_info_bulk

function.name: get_drug_interactions_all_pairs

function.name: get_drug_interaction

Returns:

        "error": str
    }

Constraints:
    - Both medication_id_1 and medication_id_2 must exist in self.medications.
    - Interactions must be checked in both directions (medication_id_1 ↔ medication_id_2).

function.name: add_medication_to_user

function.name: update_user_medication_status

function.name: remove_medication_from_user

function.name: add_drug_interaction

Add or update a drug interaction record in the knowledge base.

function.name: remove_drug_interaction

function.name: get_product_stock_quantity
function.description:
Get the current stock quantity (inventory) for a product.

Args:
    product_id (str): The identifier of the product.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": int  # The product's stock_quantity
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure (e.g. Product not found)
    }

Constraints:
    - Only products listed in the catalog (self.products) are valid.

function.name: list_cart_items
function.description:
List all products and quantities present in a user's cart.

Args:
    user_id (str): The ID of the user whose cart is to be listed.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[dict],  # Each dict contains: product_id, name, category, price, quantity
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Description of the error (e.g. user or cart not found)
    }

Constraints:
    - Each cart is associated with one user.
    - Only products listed in the catalog can appear in carts.
    - Cart items are aggregated by product.

function.name: check_product_in_cart
function.description:
Check if a specific product is present as a cart item in the given cart.

Args:
    cart_id (str): ID of the cart to inspect.
    product_id (str): ID of the product to search for in the cart.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": CartItemInfo if found, or None if not present
    }
    or
    dict: {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason why the query failed
    }

Constraints:
    - The cart identified by cart_id must exist.
    - The product identified by product_id must exist in the catalog.

function.name: add_product_to_cart
function.description:
Add a product to the specified cart. If already present, increment its quantity; else, create a new cart item.

Args:
    cart_id (str): The identifier of the cart to modify.
    product_id (str): The identifier of the product to add.
    quantity (int): The quantity of the product to add (must be > 0).

Returns:
    dict: 
        Success: { "success": True, "message": "Product added/incremented in cart." }
        Failure: { "success": False, "error": <reason> }

Constraints:
    - The cart must exist.
    - The product must exist in the catalog.
    - The quantity to add must be > 0.
    - The total quantity of this product in this cart after addition must not exceed product's stock_quantity.
    - Only one entry per product per cart (aggregated quantity).

function.name: update_cart_item_quantity
function.description:
Update the quantity of an existing cart item in a cart.

Args:
    cart_id (str): The cart where the product is present.
    product_id (str): The product to update quantity for.
    new_quantity (int): The new quantity to set (if <=0, item is removed).

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": str  # Description of the operation performed.
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str
    }

Constraints:
    - The cart and product must both exist.
    - The cart must contain the product already.
    - The new quantity cannot exceed product's stock_quantity.
    - Only products listed in catalog can be updated.
    - If new_quantity <= 0, the item is removed from the cart.

function.name: remove_product_from_cart
function.description:
Remove a product entry from the specified cart.

Args:
    cart_id (str): The identifier of the cart.
    product_id (str): The identifier of the product to remove.

Returns:
    dict: 
        On success:
            {
                "success": True,
                "message": "Product successfully removed from cart."
            }
        On failure:
            {
                "success": False,
                "error": "reason for failure"
            }

Constraints:
    - The cart must exist.
    - The cart must contain the product.
    - The same product can only appear once per cart.

function.name: create_cart_for_user
function.description:
Create a new cart instance for the user if none exists.

Args:
    user_id (str): The ID of the user for whom to create the cart.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": str,  # "Cart created"
        "cart": CartInfo,  # Newly created cart info
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure (user does not exist, cart already exists)
    }

Constraints:
    - The user must exist in the system.
    - Each user can have only one active cart.

function.name: decrement_product_stock_quantity
function.description:
Decrease the stock_quantity of a product in the catalog.

Args:
    product_id (str): Product to decrement stock for.
    quantity (int): How much to decrease stock by (must be positive).

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Product stock decremented. New stock: <int>."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure (not found, insufficient stock, etc.)
    }

Constraints:
    - Can only decrement if product exists in catalog.
    - Can only decrement by <= current stock.
    - Quantity to decrement must be positive.

function.name: clear_cart
function.description:
Remove all items from the specified cart, resetting it.

Args:
    cart_id (str): The cart identifier to clear.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Cart cleared successfully."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": reason
    }

Constraints:
    - The cart must exist.
    - All items for the cart will be removed (cart will be empty).

function.name: set_cart_updated_time
function.description:
Update the 'updated_a' (last updated timestamp) of the specified cart.

Args:
    cart_id (str): Unique identifier for the cart.
    updated_a (str): New timestamp value to set for 'updated_a'.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Cart updated_a timestamp updated successfully."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure (e.g., cart does not exist)
    }

Constraints:
    - The cart_id must exist in the system.

bad_patterns: 在环境 env_172_rl中，add_product_to_cart 前不 check_product_in_catalog / get_product_stock_quantity，超卖或把同名不同 SKU 加进购物车。
skills: 使用环境 env_172_rl时，get_user_by_name → get_cart_by_user_id（没有则 create_cart_for_user），再用 get_product_by_name/id 和 get_product_stock_quantity 核对库存。list_cart_items 后按需 update_cart_item_quantity / remove_product_from_cart；下单只针对车里真实 SKU，不要用商品名猜测库存。

function.name: get_user_by_id
function.description:
Retrieve a user's profile and role using their unique _id.

Args:
    user_id (str): The unique identifier for the user.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": UserInfo  # All user info if found
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # "User not found" if no such _id
    }

Constraints:
    - The user_id must exist in the platform.

function.name: get_user_by_email
function.description:
Look up user identity and role by registered email.

Args:
    email (str): The registered email address to look up. Search is case-insensitive.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": UserInfo  # All info about the matched user
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Description of the error, e.g. "User not found"
    }

Constraints:
    - Email is assumed unique per user.
    - Case-insensitive search for email.

function.name: check_user_authentication
function.description:
Verifies if the given user is authenticated (credential matches stored).

Args:
    user_id (str): Unique user identifier.
    provided_credential (str): Credential provided by user for authentication.

Returns:
    dict:
        {
            "success": True,
            "data": UserInfo  # User information dictionary
        }
        or
        {
            "success": False,
            "error": str  # Reason for authentication failure
        }

Constraints:
    - User must exist in the system (user_id present)
    - Credential must match user's authentication_credential

function.name: get_user_role
function.description:
Get the role ('patient' or 'provider') of a user by their ID.

Args:
    user_id (str): The identifier of the user.

Returns:
    dict: 
        On success:
            {
                "success": True,
                "data": { "role": str }
            }
        On failure:
            {
                "success": False,
                "error": "User not found"
            }

Constraints:
    - User must exist in the system.

function.name: list_user_consultations
function.description:
List all consultations where the specified user is a participant,
either as a patient or provider.

Args:
    user_id (str): Unique user identifier.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[ConsultationInfo],  # Consultations where user is patient or provider
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # 'User not found' if invalid user_id
    }

Constraints:
    - user_id must exist in platform users.

function.name: get_consultation_by_id
function.description:
Retrieve the full details for a specific consultation session.

Args:
    consultation_id (str): Unique identifier for the consultation.

Returns:
    dict: 
        - On success: {'success': True, 'data': ConsultationInfo}
        - On failure: {'success': False, 'error': 'Consultation not found'}

Constraints:
    - Consultation with the provided ID must exist.

function.name: list_provider_consultations
function.description:
List all consultations assigned to the specified provider.

Args:
    provider_id (str): Unique user ID of provider.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[ConsultationInfo],  # All consultations where provider_id matches (may be empty)
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure (provider does not exist or is not a provider)
    }

Constraints:
    - provider_id must exist in self.users and must have role 'provider'.

function.name: list_images_for_consultation
function.description:
Retrieve all image files and associated metadata linked to a specific consultation.

Args:
    consultation_id (str): Unique identifier for the target consultation.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[ImageInfo],  # may be empty if no images are linked
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # error message, e.g. 'Consultation does not exist'
    }

Constraints:
    - consultation_id must exist in the system.
    - No explicit privacy rules enforced in this query.

function.name: get_image_metadata
function.description:
Retrieve metadata for the specified image.

Args:
    image_id (str): Unique identifier for the image.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": {
            "image_id": str,
            "user_id": str,
            "consultation_id": str,
            "file_location": str,
            "upload_timestamp": str,
            "body_location": str,
            "metadata": dict,
        }
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "Image not found"
    }

Constraints:
    - The image must exist in the platform's records.
    - No privacy/access checks performed in this method (for metadata only).

function.name: can_user_access_image
function.description:
Determine if a given user is permitted to access/view an image based on privacy and medical data rules.

Args:
    user_id (str): The ID of the user requesting image access.
    image_id (str): The ID of the image to check.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": bool  # True if access is permitted, False otherwise.
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure (e.g., user or image not found)
    }

Constraints:
    - Providers can view only consultations assigned to them.
    - Images must comply with medical privacy (only patient and assigned provider may view).

function.name: create_consultation
function.description:
Initiate a new consultation (only allowed for users with role 'patient').

Args:
    patient_id (str): User ID of the patient initiating the consultation.
    provider_id (str): User ID of the provider (must exist and have 'provider' role).
    start_time (str): Start time for the consultation (ISO format or string).
    note (str): Optional note for the consultation.

Returns:
    dict:
        success (bool): True if creation succeeded, False otherwise.
        message (str): Success description if succeeded.
        error (str): Error reason if failed.

Constraints:
    - patient_id and provider_id must refer to existing users.
    - Only patients can initiate (user[patient_id] must have role 'patient').
    - provider_id must have role 'provider'.

function.name: upload_image_to_consultation
function.description:
Upload a new dermatology analysis image, linking to an existing or new consultation.

Args:
    user_id (str): The ID of the user uploading the image.
    authentication_credential (str): The credential/token for user authentication.
    file_location (str): The location/path of the uploaded image file.
    upload_timestamp (str): Timestamp marking when upload occurs.
    body_location (str): Human body location relevant to the image.
    metadata (dict): Any additional metadata for the image.
    consultation_id (Optional[str]): Existing consultation to link to, or None to create new.
    provider_id (Optional[str]): Required only when creating new consultation.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Image uploaded and linked to consultation"
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "reason"
    }

Constraints:
    - Only authenticated users may upload images.
    - If creating new consultation, only patients may initiate; must provide provider_id.
    - Images must be linked to an existing or new consultation.

function.name: update_consultation_note
function.description:
Add or update the notes/details associated with a consultation record.

Args:
    consultation_id (str): The unique identifier of the consultation to update.
    note (str): The textual note to set or modify.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Consultation note updated successfully."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure, e.g. consultation not found or invalid note
    }

Constraints:
    - Consultation ID must correspond to an existing consultation.
    - Note must be a string.

function.name: update_image_metadata
function.description:
Modify metadata fields of a stored image (e.g., body_location).

Args:
    image_id (str): The unique identifier for the image to update.
    metadata_updates (dict): Dictionary of metadata keys and their new values. For body_location, pass as a key.

Returns:
    dict:
        - On success: { "success": True, "message": "Image metadata updated." }
        - On failure: { "success": False, "error": "<reason>" }

Constraints:
    - Image with the specified image_id must exist.
    - Only metadata fields and body_location can be updated.
    - No authentication/user access logic is enforced in this method.

function.name: restrict_image_access
function.description:
Apply or modify access restrictions on a given image to comply with privacy regulations.

Args:
    image_id (str): The identifier of the image to restrict.
    restrictions (dict): Restriction details, e.g., {'restricted': True} or other access-control fields.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Access restrictions updated for image <image_id>"
    }
    OR
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "Image not found or invalid restriction input"
    }

Constraints:
    - Image must exist in platform.
    - Restrictions argument must be a dictionary.
    - Only restriction (access control) fields in metadata are modified; other metadata remains intact.

function.name: remove_image_from_consultation
function.description:
Delete an image from a consultation for privacy, error correction, or compliance reasons.

Args:
    image_id (str): Unique identifier for the image to be removed.
    user_id (str): The user attempting the removal (for authentication/authorization).

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": f"Image {image_id} removed from consultation."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure
    }

Constraints:
    - Only the image uploader, assigned provider in the consultation, or compliance/admin may remove the image.
    - The image must exist and be linked to a consultation.
    - Image access must comply with privacy/medical regulations.

bad_patterns: 在环境 env_173_rl中，upload_image_to_consultation 不检查 can_user_access_image，或未登录就 create_consultation。
skills: 使用环境 env_173_rl时，check_user_authentication 和 get_user_role 后 create_consultation。图像上传前 can_user_access_image；完成后 list_images_for_consultation / get_image_metadata 与 list_user_consultations 对齐，不要把本地文件名当成已入档皮损图。

function.name: get_employee_by_id
function.description:
Retrieve information for a specific employee by their unique ID.

Args:
    employee_id (str): Unique identifier for the employee.

Returns:
    dict: 
        - If employee exists:
            { "success": True, "data": EmployeeInfo }
        - If employee does not exist:
            { "success": False, "error": "Employee not found" }

Constraints:
    - The employee_id must exist in the system.

function.name: list_active_enrollment_periods
function.description:
Get all currently open enrollment periods where is_active == True.

Args:
    None.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[EnrollmentPeriodInfo],  # List of active enrollment periods, or empty if none.
    }

function.name: get_current_active_enrollment_period
function.description:
Returns the currently active/open enrollment period if one exists.

Args:
    None

Returns:
    dict:
        - On success:
            {
                "success": True,
                "data": EnrollmentPeriodInfo  # The info of the active period
            }
        - On failure (no active period):
            {
                "success": False,
                "error": "No active enrollment period."
            }

Constraints:
    - Ideally, only one enrollment period should have is_active == True.
    - If multiple, returns the first found active period.

function.name: get_employee_eligibility_profile
function.description:
Query the eligibility profile string of an employee.

Args:
    employee_id (str): Unique identifier of the employee.

Returns:
    dict:
        - On success: {"success": True, "data": str} (the eligibility_profile for the employee)
        - On error: {"success": False, "error": str} ('Employee not found')

Constraints:
    - Employee must exist in self.employees.

function.name: list_all_benefit_plans
function.description:
Retrieve all available benefit plans in the system (unfiltered by employee eligibility or plan type).

Args:
    None

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[BenefitPlanInfo],  # List of all benefit plans (may be empty if none exist)
    }

function.name: list_benefit_plans_by_type
function.description:
Get benefit plans filtered by plan_type.

Args:
    plan_type (str): The type/category of benefits to filter by (e.g., "health insurance").

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[BenefitPlanInfo],  # List of matching benefit plans
    }
    If no plans match, "data" is an empty list.

Constraints:
    - No eligibility or enrollment period checks are enforced for this query.
    - Comparison is literal: only plans with BenefitPlanInfo["plan_type"] == plan_type are returned.

function.name: list_eligible_benefit_plans_for_employee
function.description:
List benefit plans that match the employee's eligibility profile and are available to them.

Args:
    employee_id (str): ID of the employee.

Returns:
    dict: 
      {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[BenefitPlanInfo]  # List of eligible benefit plans (may be empty)
      }
      OR
      {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Error message if employee does not exist
      }

Constraints:
    - Only benefit plans whose eligibility_criteria match the employee's eligibility_profile are listed.
    - If employee does not exist, return an error.

function.name: list_available_plan_options_for_employee_in_open_enrollment
get_plan_details
function.description:
Retrieve full details for a benefit plan by its plan_id.

Args:
    plan_id (str): The identifier of the benefit plan.

Returns:
    dict:
        - Success: { "success": True, "data": BenefitPlanInfo }
        - Failure: { "success": False, "error": "Benefit plan not found" }

Constraints:
    - No constraints: Information retrieval only.

function.name: get_employee_plan_selections_in_period
function.description:
List all plan selections for a specific employee during a given enrollment period.

Args:
    employee_id (str): Unique ID of the employee.
    enrollment_period_id (str): Unique ID of the enrollment period.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[EmployeePlanSelectionInfo]
    }
    or {
        "success": False,
        "error": str
    }

Constraints:
    - employee_id must exist in self.employees.
    - enrollment_period_id must exist in self.enrollment_periods.

function.name: get_employee_current_selection
function.description:
Get the currently active benefit plan selection for an employee (if any),
during the currently active enrollment period.

Args:
    employee_id (str): Unique employee identifier.

Returns:
    dict:
        {
            "success": True,
            "data": EmployeePlanSelectionInfo | None  # Selection info or None if not found
        }
        OR
        {
            "success": False,
            "error": str  # Error description (employee not found, no active enrollment period)
        }

Constraints:
    - Employee must exist.
    - There must be an active enrollment period.

function.name: enroll_employee_in_plan
function.description:
Add or update an employee’s plan selection during an active enrollment period.

Args:
    employee_id (str): Employee’s unique ID.
    plan_id (str): Benefit plan’s unique ID.
    enrollment_period_id (str): Enrollment period’s unique ID.
    selection_date (str): Date/time of selection (ISO string).

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Employee plan selection recorded/updated for enrollment period."
    }
    OR
    dict: {
        "success": False,
        "error": "<reason>"
    }

Constraints:
    - Enrollment period must be active.
    - Employee, plan, and period must all exist.
    - Employee must be eligible for the plan.

function.name: change_employee_plan_selection
function.description:
Modify/replace the selected plan for an employee within the current active enrollment period.

Args:
    employee_id (str): ID of the employee.
    new_plan_id (str): ID of the new plan to enroll in.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Employee's plan selection updated to new plan."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "Reason for failure."
    }

Constraints:
    - Enrollment period must be active.
    - Employee and plan must exist.
    - Employee must be eligible for chosen plan.
    - Employee must already have a selection to modify for active period.

function.name: withdraw_employee_plan_selection
function.description:
Removes/withdraws an employee's plan selection for the current active enrollment period (opts out).

Args:
    employee_id (str): The ID of the employee wishing to withdraw their selection.

Returns:
    dict: 
        On success:
            {
                "success": True,
                "message": "Employee plan selection withdrawn for current enrollment period."
            }
        On failure:
            {
                "success": False,
                "error": str  # Description of why withdrawal was not possible
            }

Constraints:
    - There must be at least one active enrollment period.
    - The employee must exist.
    - Employee must have an existing plan selection in the current active enrollment period.

function.name: create_new_enrollment_period
function.description:
Add a new enrollment period to the portal (admin action).

Args:
    enrollment_period_id (str): Unique ID for the enrollment period.
    start_date (str): Enrollment period start date (YYYY-MM-DD format recommended).
    end_date (str): Enrollment period end date (YYYY-MM-DD format recommended).
    is_active (bool): Whether the period is currently active.

Returns:
    dict: Success or error message.
        {"success": True, "message": "Enrollment period created successfully."}
        or
        {"success": False, "error": "<reason>"}

Constraints:
    - enrollment_period_id must be unique.
    - start_date should be ≤ end_date.

function.name: activate_enrollment_period
function.description:
Set the status of an enrollment period to active ("is_active"=True).

Args:
    enrollment_period_id (str): The unique ID of the enrollment period to activate.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Enrollment period <id> activated."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "<reason>"
    }

Constraints:
    - Enrollment period must exist in the system to activate.
    - Idempotent: If already active, still considered success.

function.name: deactivate_enrollment_period
function.description:
Deactivate an enrollment period by setting its status to inactive.

Args:
    enrollment_period_id (str): The unique ID of the enrollment period to deactivate.

Returns:
    dict: 
        {
            "success": True,
            "message": "Enrollment period <id> deactivated."
        }
        OR
        {
            "success": False,
            "error": "Enrollment period does not exist."
        }
        OR
        {
            "success": True,
            "message": "Enrollment period <id> was already inactive."
        }

Constraints:
    - Enrollment period must exist.

function.name: add_benefit_plan
function.description:
Add a new benefit plan to the catalog.

Args:
    plan_id (str): Unique identifier for the plan.
    plan_type (str): Category/type of the benefit plan.
    name (str): Name of the plan.
    coverage_details (str): Detailed coverage description.
    premiums (float): Cost of the plan.
    eligibility_criteria (str): Criteria for employee eligibility.

Returns:
    dict: 
        - On success: {"success": True, "message": "Benefit plan added successfully."}
        - On failure: {"success": False, "error": <reason>}

Constraints:
    - plan_id must be unique; cannot already exist.
    - premiums must be non-negative.
    - Required fields must be non-empty.

function.name: update_benefit_plan
function.description:
Modify the attributes/details of a benefit plan (admin action).

Args:
    plan_id (str): Unique ID of the benefit plan to update.
    plan_type (Optional[str]): New type of the plan.
    name (Optional[str]): New display name for the plan.

Returns:
    dict: 
        {
            "success": True,
            "data": [MoodEntryInfo, ...]  # List of matching mood entry infos (may be empty)
        }
        or
        {
            "success": False,
            "error": str  # Description of error (invalid user or mood type)
        }
Constraints:
    - user_id must exist in self.users
    - mood_type_id must exist in self.mood_types

function.name: add_mood_entry
function.description:
Create a new mood entry for a user.

Args:
    user_id (str): The ID of the user recording the mood.
    mood_type (str): The mood type to record (must exist in MoodTypes).
    description (str): Optional notes about the mood entry.
    metadata (dict, optional): Additional metadata. Defaults to empty dict.
    timestamp (float, optional): Unix timestamp for the mood entry. If None, uses current time.

Returns:
    dict: 
        {"success": True, "message": "Mood entry created with id <entry_id>"}
    or
        {"success": False, "error": "reason"}

Constraints:
    - User must exist.
    - MoodType must exist.
    - Timestamp must not be in the future.

function.name: edit_mood_entry
function.description:
Update description, mood_type, metadata, or timestamp of a user's own mood entry.

Args:
    entry_id (str): ID of the mood entry to edit.
    user_id (str): ID of the user requesting the edit.
    description (str, optional): New description.
    mood_type (str, optional): New mood_type. Must be valid.
    metadata (dict, optional): New metadata.
    timestamp (float, optional): New timestamp. Must not be in the future.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Mood entry updated successfully."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "reason for failure"
    }

Constraints:
    - Only the owner can edit their mood entry.
    - Only valid mood types may be set.
    - Timestamps cannot be in the future.

function.name: delete_mood_entry
function.description:
Remove a mood entry, if and only if it belongs to the current user.

Args:
    entry_id (str): Unique identifier for the mood entry to be deleted.
    current_user_id (str): User ID of the user requesting deletion.

Returns:
    dict: On success:
        {
            "success": True,
            "message": "Mood entry deleted successfully."
        }
        On error:
        {
            "success": False,
            "error": str  # Error message
        }

Constraints:
    - Only the user who owns the mood entry may delete it.
    - If the entry doesn't exist, return a failure result.

function.name: bulk_delete_user_mood_entries
function.description:
Remove multiple mood entries belonging to the specified user.

Args:
    user_id (str): The ID of the user whose mood entries should be deleted.
    entry_ids (list of str): List of mood entry IDs to delete.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Deleted X of Y requested entries for user <user_id>.",
        "deleted_entries": List[str],  # Entry IDs that were actually deleted
        "skipped_entries": List[str],  # Entry IDs not deleted (not found or not belonging to user)
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # e.g. user does not exist
    }

Constraints:
    - Only mood entries belonging to the specified user will be deleted.
    - Entries that do not exist or do not belong to the user are skipped.
    - If user_id does not exist, operation fails.

function.name: change_mood_type_label
function.description:
Modify the label or other properties (color, emoji) of an existing MoodType.
Only valid properties (label, color, emoji) can be modified.

Args:
    mood_type_id (str): The ID of the mood type to modify.
    label (str, optional): New label for the mood type.
    color (str, optional): New color for the mood type.
    emoji (str, optional): New emoji for the mood type.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Mood type properties updated"
    }
    OR
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "<reason>"
    }

Constraints:
    - mood_type_id must exist in mood_types.
    - At least one property to update (label, color, emoji) must be provided.
    - Only label, color, emoji can be modified.

function.name: restore_deleted_mood_entry
function.description:
Reinstate a previously deleted mood entry (if deletion is a soft delete or undo is supported).

Args:
    entry_id (str): The ID of the mood entry to restore.
    user_id (str): The ID of the user requesting restoration.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": f"Mood entry {entry_id} successfully restored."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure
    }

Constraints:
    - Only owners may restore their own deleted entries.
    - Entry must exist and be marked deleted (soft delete).
    - Entry must reference a valid user and valid mood type (if applicable).

bad_patterns: 在环境 env_177_rl中，add_mood_entry 使用了未在 list_mood_types 中的类型，或 bulk_delete 误删时间窗外记录。
skills: 使用环境 env_177_rl时，get_mood_type_by_id 只选 list_mood_types 里的枚举。筛选用 filter_mood_entries_by_time / filter_mood_entries_by_type 后再 edit/delete。批量删除前先列出 id 集合，用 get_mood_entry_by_id 抽查边界，不要按用户名清空全部。

function.name: get_hospital_by_name
function.description:
Retrieve hospital metadata (including hospital_id) by its name.

Args:
    name (str): The name of the hospital to look up.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": HospitalInfo  # The matching hospital's info
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # "Hospital not found" if no match
    }

Constraints:
    - Hospital names are assumed unique. If multiple found, returns the first.
    - Performs an exact (case-sensitive) match.

function.name: list_beds_by_hospital
function.description:
List all beds (with their current status and metadata) for a specific hospital.

Args:
    hospital_id (str): The unique identifier for the hospital.

Returns:
    dict: 
        {
            "success": True,
            "data": List[BedInfo]  # All beds belonging to the hospital (may be empty)
        }
    or
        {
            "success": False,
            "error": str  # Reason (e.g. hospital not found)
        }

Constraints:
    - The hospital_id must exist.
    - If no beds found, the returned list is empty (not an error).

function.name: list_available_beds_by_hospital
function.description:
List all beds in a hospital that are currently available for reservation.

Args:
    hospital_id (str): Unique identifier for the hospital.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[BedInfo],  # List of beds with status "available" in the hospital
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason, e.g., hospital not found
    }

Constraints:
    - The hospital_id must correspond to an existing hospital.

function.name: get_patient_by_name
function.description:
Retrieve patient information(s) given a patient name.

Args:
    name (str): The (case-sensitive) name of the patient to search for.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[PatientInfo]  # List of matching patient(s); empty if nobody found.
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Description of the error (e.g., empty name).
    }

Constraints:
    - Name must be a non-empty string.
    - Multiple patients may have the same name; all matches are returned.
    - No error if no patient matches; return empty list.

function.name: get_patient_by_id
function.description:
Retrieve patient info by patient_id.

Args:
    patient_id (str): Unique identifier for the patient.

Returns:
    dict: 
        On success:
            {
                "success": True,
                "data": PatientInfo  # all fields
            }
        On failure:
            {
                "success": False,
                "error": "Patient not found"
            }

Constraints:
    - Patient must exist in the environment.

function.name: get_staff_by_id
function.description:
Lookup staff information for a given staff_id.

Args:
    staff_id (str): The unique identifier of the staff member.

Returns:
    dict: 
        - If found: { "success": True, "data": StaffInfo }
        - If not found: { "success": False, "error": "Staff not found" }

Constraints:
    - No additional constraints except the staff_id must exist.

function.name: list_beds_by_patient
function.description:
List all beds either assigned to or reserved by the specified patient.

Args:
    patient_id (str): Unique patient identifier.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[BedInfo]  # may be empty if no assignments/reservations
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str
    }

Constraints:
    - Patient must exist in the system.
    - Will not list duplicate beds (if both assigned and reserved).

function.name: list_reservations_by_patient
function.description:
List all reservations linked to a given patient.

Args:
    patient_id (str): Unique patient identifier.

Returns:
    dict:
        success (bool): True if patient found, False otherwise.
        data (List[ReservationInfo]): List of reservation records for the patient (may be empty).
        error (str, optional): Reason, if patient not found.

Constraints:
    - Patient must exist in the system (self.patients).

function.name: get_bed_info_by_id
function.description:
Retrieve full information about a specific bed by its bed_id.

Args:
    bed_id (str): Unique identifier of the bed.

Returns:
    dict: 
        - On success: {"success": True, "data": BedInfo}
        - If not found: {"success": False, "error": "Bed not found"}

Constraints:
    - No additional constraints; simple information query.

function.name: get_reservation_by_id
function.description:
Retrieve full details of a specific reservation entry by its reservation_id.

Args:
    reservation_id (str): The reservation's unique identifier.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": ReservationInfo  # Full reservation entry if found
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # 'Reservation not found'
    }

Constraints:
    - reservation_id must exist in self.reservations

function.name: reserve_bed
function.description:
Reserve an available bed under a given patient by a staff member.
Updates bed status, patient linkage, timestamps, and logs reservation for audit.

Args:
    bed_id (str): ID of the bed to reserve.
    patient_id (str): ID of the patient to link reservation.
    staff_id (str): ID of the staff member making the reservation.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": str  # Success message
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Failure reason
    }

Constraints:
    - Bed must exist and be "available".
    - Patient and Staff must exist.
    - Bed status is changed to "reserved" and linked to patient.
    - Reservation record is created for auditability.

function.name: bulk_reserve_beds
function.description:
Reserve multiple available beds for a single patient in one transaction.

Args:
    patient_id (str): ID of the patient for whom beds should be reserved.
    bed_ids (List[str]): List of bed IDs to reserve.
    staff_id (str): ID of the staff making the reservation.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": <summary string>,
        "reserved_bed_ids": List[str],    # successfully reserved bed IDs
        "skipped_bed_ids": List[str],     # IDs of beds that could not be reserved (not available or missing)
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str                      # error description (e.g., missing patient/staff)
    }

Constraints:
    - A bed can only be reserved if its status is "available".
    - The patient and staff must exist.
    - Reservation actions must be attributed to staff.

function.name: cancel_reservation
function.description:
Cancels an existing reservation:
    - Updates reservation status to "cancelled"
    - Reverts linked bed's status to "available" if appropriate
    - Clears assigned_patient_id and reservation_timestamp for that bed if necessary

Args:
    reservation_id (str): The ID of the reservation to cancel.

Returns:
    dict:
        - On success: { "success": True, "message": "Reservation cancelled and bed status reverted." }
        - On failure: { "success": False, "error": str }

Constraints:
    - Reservation must exist.
    - Only cancel if the reservation is still active.
    - Bed status must be reverted to available (unless already available).
    - Maintain auditability by updating status fields.

function.name: assign_patient_to_bed
function.description:
Assign a patient to a reserved bed, marking the bed as occupied.

Args:
    patient_id (str): The ID of the patient to assign.
    bed_id (str): The ID of the bed to assign to the patient.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Patient assigned to bed and marked as occupied."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Error explanation
    }

Constraints:
    - Bed must exist and status must be "reserved".
    - Patient must exist.
    - There must be an active reservation linking patient and bed.
    - A bed cannot be assigned to more than one patient at the same time.

function.name: release_bed
function.description:
Frees up an occupied or reserved bed, making it available.

Args:
    bed_id (str): Unique identifier of the bed to release.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": str  # Description of release action
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str    # Reason why release wasn't done
    }

Constraints:
    - The specified bed must exist.
    - Only beds with status 'reserved' or 'occupied' can be released.
    - Upon release, bed status is set to 'available', assigned patient/linkage cleared, reservation_timestamp cleared.

function.name: update_bed_status
function.description:
Change the status of a bed ("available", "reserved", "occupied") as per workflow requirements.

Args:
    bed_id (str): Unique identifier of the bed to update.
    new_status (str): Target status; must be one of "available", "reserved", "occupied".

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Bed status updated to <new_status>."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "Reason for failure (invalid id/status/constraint violation)."
    }

Constraints:
    - Bed must exist.
    - `new_status` must be valid.
    - Status changes must comply with business rules:
        - Reservation can only occur when bed is "available".
        - Occupy typically means reserved first (not strictly enforced if workflow allows).
        - Setting to "available" may clear patient/reservation fields.

function.name: create_reservation
function.description:
Create a new reservation record for audit/history tracking.

Args:
    patient_id (str): Unique ID of the patient associated with the reservation.
    bed_id (str): Unique ID of the bed being reserved.
    staff_id (str): Unique ID of the staff making the reservation (audit attribution).
    reservation_timestamp (str): ISO-formatted timestamp of reservation creation.
    reservation_status (str, optional): Status for the reservation record, defaults to "active".

Returns:
    dict: 
        Success: { "success": True, "message": "Created reservation <reservation_id>." }
        Failure: { "success": False, "error": "reason" }

Constraints:
    - patient_id, bed_id, staff_id must exist in the system.
    - All fields required for creating reservation.
    - This does NOT change bed status, only records reservation for audit/history.

function.name: update_reservation_status
function.description:
Change the status of an existing reservation (e.g., "active", "cancelled").

Args:
    reservation_id (str): The ID of the reservation to update.
    new_status (str): The target status ("active" or "cancelled").

Returns:
    dict:
        - success: True if updated, False otherwise.
        - message: Confirmation on success.
        - error: Reason for failure.

Constraints:
    - Reservation must exist in self.reservations.
    - new_status must be "active" or "cancelled".

function.name: transfer_bed_assignment
function.description:
Reassign a reserved bed from one patient to another, enforcing all hospital bed constraints.

Args:
    bed_id (str): Unique identifier of the bed to transfer.
    new_patient_id (str): Unique identifier of the patient to be newly assigned the bed.

Returns:
    dict: 
        On success:
            {
                "success": True,
                "message": "Bed assignment transferred from old_patient_id to new_patient_id for bed bed_id."
            }
        On failure:
            { 
                "success": False,
                "error": str  # Reason for failure (bed not found, not reserved, etc.)
            }

Constraints:
    - Bed must exist and currently have status "reserved".
    - new_patient_id must exist.
    - Only one patient can be linked to a bed at a time.
    - Reservation must exist and be active for the bed.

bad_patterns: 在环境 env_178_rl中，没用 list_available_beds_by_hospital 就 reserve_bed / bulk_reserve_beds，把占用床位再次分给新患者。
skills: 使用环境 env_178_rl时，get_hospital_by_name → list_available_beds_by_hospital，再用 get_patient_by_name/id 绑定。reserve_bed 后 get_bed_info_by_id 和 list_reservations_by_patient 确认床位空闲标记已翻转；批量占用逐张核对，不要按病房名估算空床。

function.name: get_subscriber_by_email
function.description:
Retrieve subscriber details using their email address.

Args:
    email_address (str): The email address to query for.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": SubscriberInfo  # Details of the found subscriber
    }

        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Error message if subscriber not found
    }

Constraints:
    - The provided email address must exist in the system.
    - Assumes email address is unique per subscriber.

function.name: get_subscriber_by_id
function.description:
Retrieve subscriber details using their unique identifier.

Args:
    subscriber_id (str): The unique identifier for the subscriber.

Returns:
    dict:
        - success: True and data (SubscriberInfo) if found.
        - success: False and error message if subscriber not found.

Constraints:
    - The subscriber_id must exist within the system.

function.name: list_subscriptions_for_subscriber
function.description:
List all alert subscriptions associated with a particular subscriber.

Args:
    subscriber_id (str): Unique identifier for the subscriber.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[SubscriptionInfo],  # List of subscriptions (empty if none)
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Error description, e.g. "Subscriber does not exist"
    }

Constraints:
    - Provided subscriber_id must exist within self.subscribers.

function.name: check_subscription_exists_for_location
function.description:
Determine if a subscriber already has a subscription at the given latitude and longitude.

Args:
    subscriber_id (str): The unique identifier of the subscriber.
    latitude (float): Latitude to check.
    longitude (float): Longitude to check.

Returns:
    dict:
        {
            "success": True,
            "data": bool  # True if subscription exists, False if not
        }
        or
        {
            "success": False,
            "error": str  # Error description
        }

Constraints:
    - Only consider subscriptions of the given subscriber.
    - Latitude must be between -90 and 90, longitude between -180 and 180.

function.name: validate_location
function.description:
Checks if the given latitude and longitude values are valid for a subscription.

Args:
    latitude (float): Latitude value to validate.
    longitude (float): Longitude value to validate.

Returns:
    dict:
        Success: {
            "success": True,
            "data": { "valid": True }
        }
        Failure: {
            "success": False,
            "error": str  # Description of invalidity.
        }

Constraints:
    - Latitude must be within [-90.0, 90.0].
    - Longitude must be within [-180.0, 180.0].

function.name: get_active_subscriptions
function.description:
Retrieve all currently active subscriptions in the system.

Args:
    None

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[SubscriptionInfo],  # subscriptions with 'active' status & valid location
    }

Constraints:
    - Only include subscriptions where active_status == 'active'.
    - Latitude must be in [-90, 90], longitude in [-180, 180].

function.name: get_outbreaks_near_location

Find current (ongoing) outbreaks whose affected area intersects the given location.

Args:
    latitude (float): Latitude of the location [-90, 90].
    longitude (float): Longitude of the location [-180, 180].

Returns:
    dict:

        - success: False, error: str (invalid input or type)

Constraints:
    - Only outbreaks with status 'ongoing' are considered.
    - Area intersection is determined for either [lat, lon, radius] (circle), or bounding box.
    - Latitude must be within [-90, 90], longitude within [-180, 180].

function.name: create_subscriber
function.description:
Adds a new subscriber to the system using the provided email address.

Args:
    email_address (str): The subscriber's email address to be registered.

Returns:
    dict:
        - On success:

                "error": str,  # Reason for failure (e.g. email already exists or invalid)

    - Email address must not already exist in the system.
    - (Optional) Email must be a non-empty string.

function.name: create_subscription
function.description:
Creates a new alert subscription for the provided subscriber at the specified latitude and longitude,
setting its status as 'active'.

Args:
    subscriber_id (str): The ID of the subscriber for whom the subscription is being created.
    latitude (float): Geographic latitude, must be in [-90, 90].

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Subscription created successfully."
    }
    or

        "error": str  # Reason for failure: invalid inputs, duplicate, etc.
    }

Constraints:
    - Subscriber must exist.
    - Latitude/longitude must be valid.
    - No duplicate subscription for same subscriber/location.

function.name: activate_subscription
function.description:
Set the specified subscription's status to active.

Args:
    subscription_id (str): ID of the subscription to activate.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Subscription activated"
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": <reason>
    }

Constraints:
    - Subscription must exist.
    - Latitude and longitude must be present and valid (latitude in [-90, 90], longitude in [-180, 180]).

function.name: deactivate_subscription
function.description:
Change a subscription's status to inactive, i.e., pause notifications for this subscription.

Args:
    subscription_id (str): Unique identifier for the subscription.

Returns:
    dict:
        {
            "success": True,
            "message": "Subscription <id> deactivated."

        or

            "success": False,
            "error": "Subscription not found."

Constraints:

function.name: update_subscription_location
function.description:
Modifies the latitude and longitude of an existing subscription.

Args:
    subscription_id (str): The ID of the subscription to modify.
    latitude (float): New latitude (-90 to 90).
    longitude (float): New longitude (-180 to 180).

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Subscription location updated."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": <reason str>
    }

Constraints:
    - Latitude must be between -90 and 90.
    - Longitude must be between -180 and 180.
    - Subscription must exist in the system.

function.name: delete_subscription
function.description:
Remove a subscription from a subscriber’s account.

Args:
    subscription_id (str): The unique identifier of the subscription to delete.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Subscription <subscription_id> deleted."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "Subscription not found."
    }

Constraints:
    - Subscription must exist.
    - Deleting a subscription does not remove related notifications.
    - Deletion may occur regardless of subscription status.

bad_patterns: 在环境 env_179_rl中，create_subscription 前不做 validate_location / check_subscription_exists_for_location，重复订阅或把未激活记录当成已在推送。
skills: 使用环境 env_179_rl时，用 get_subscriber_by_email 找到人，validate_location 后再 check_subscription_exists_for_location。新建后必须 activate_subscription；改地点走 update_subscription_location。用 get_active_subscriptions 和 get_outbreaks_near_location 验证推送范围，不要把 create_subscriber 当成已经订好疫情。

function.name: get_patient_by_name
function.description:
Retrieve patient information records that match the given name.

Args:
    name (str): The patient's name to search for.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[PatientInfo],  # List of PatientInfo dicts (may be empty if no matches)

        "error": str  # Error reason (e.g. empty name)
    }

Constraints:
    - If name is an empty string, returns error.

function.name: get_patient_by_id
function.description:
Retrieve patient info by unique patient_id.

Args:
    patient_id (str): The unique identifier of the patient.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": PatientInfo,
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure, usually patient not found.
    }

Constraints:

                "data": List[MedicalRecordInfo]  # List of medical records, may be empty
            }
        - On failure:
            {
                "success": False,
                "error": str  # Reason for failure
            }

Constraints:
    - The patient_id must exist in the portal.

function.name: get_medical_records_for_appointment
function.description:
List all medical records associated with the specified appointment.

Args:
    appointment_id (str): The unique identifier of the appointment.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[MedicalRecordInfo]  # list may be empty if no records
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # reason for error (e.g., appointment not found)
    }

Constraints:
    - The appointment_id must exist in the system.
    - The MedicalRecord must be associated with the appointment by 'appointment_id' attribute.
      (Assumes MedicalRecordInfo contains 'appointment_id')

function.name: check_file_type_and_size_validity
function.description:
Check if the proposed medical file's type and size meet the current upload restrictions.

Args:
    file_type (str): File type/extension (e.g., 'pdf', 'jpg', 'docx').
    file_size (int): Size in bytes.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": {
            "valid": bool,
            "reason": str (if not valid)
        }
    }

Constraints:
    - Allowed file types: pdf, jpg, png, docx.
    - Maximum allowed file size: 10MB (10,000,000 bytes).
    - file_type must be a non-empty string.
    - file_size must be non-negative.

function.name: check_record_access_permission
function.description:
Determines if a patient or provider can access/view the specified medical record.

Args:
    record_id (str): The ID of the medical record.
    user_id (str): The ID of the requesting patient or provider.
    user_type (str): Type of user, either 'patient' or 'provider'.

Returns:
    dict: 
        {
            "success": True,
            "data": bool  # True if access is permitted, False otherwise
        }
        or
        {
            "success": False,
            "error": str  # Description of the error circumstance
        }

Constraints:
    - The medical record specified by record_id must exist.
    - User must exist and match user_type.
    - Access determined by the record's access_permission and user association.

function.name: get_record_details
function.description:
Retrieve details about a single medical record by record_id.

Args:
    record_id (str): Unique identifier of the medical record.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": MedicalRecordInfo,  # All metadata about the record
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Error message if record not found
    }

Constraints:
    - The record_id must exist in the medical_records.
    - No permission checking performed in this method (for internal lookup).

function.name: upload_medical_record
function.description:
Upload a new medical file for a patient for a given appointment.
Enforces file type and size restrictions and sets initial access permissions.

Args:
    patient_id (str): Patient uploading the record.
    appointment_id (str): Associated appointment.
    file_path (str): Path to uploaded file.
    file_type (str): The file extension/type.
    file_size (int): File size in bytes.
    upload_datetime (str): Upload timestamp (ISO string).
    description (str): Optional metadata for the record.
    access_permission (str): Initial access permission string.

Returns:
    dict:
        success (bool): Whether upload succeeded.
        message (str): Description of success.
        or
        error (str): Reason for failure.
    
Constraints:
    - Patient must exist.
    - Appointment must exist and belong to patient.
    - Only authorized patients can upload for their own appointments.
    - File type/size must be valid.
    - Medical record must be associated with patient and appointment.

function.name: associate_record_with_appointment
function.description:
Links an existing medical record to a specific appointment, if not already associated.

Args:
    record_id (str): The ID of the medical record to be linked.
    appointment_id (str): The ID of the appointment to link to.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Medical record linked to appointment successfully."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "<reason for failure>"
    }

Constraints:
    - Both record and appointment must exist.
    - Only link records and appointments for the same patient.
    - Record can't be associated with multiple appointments.
    - Links must be unique.

function.name: update_record_access_permission
function.description:
Modify the access_permission of a specified medical record.

Args:
    record_id (str): The unique identifier of the medical record.
    new_permission (str): The new permission string to be set.
    requester_id (str): The patient or provider initiating the change, for authorization.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Access permission updated successfully"
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Description of the error
    }

Constraints:
    - Only authorized patients (owners of the record) or authorized providers/admins can update the permission.
    - record_id must exist.
    - new_permission should be a valid permission string.

function.name: delete_medical_record
function.description:
Removes a medical record from the system, enforcing access/restriction checks.

Args:
    record_id (str): Unique identifier for the medical record to delete.
    requester_id (str): Patient (or provider) requesting the operation.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Medical record deleted successfully"
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": <str describing problem>
    }

Constraints:
- Record must exist.
- Only the record's owning patient can delete their own medical record.
- All references in the system (appointments, etc.) should be considered if applicable.

function.name: update_medical_record_metadata
function.description:
Edit metadata of an existing medical record (e.g., update description, access_permission).

Args:
    record_id (str): Unique medical record identifier.
    description (str, optional): New description for the record.
    access_permission (str, optional): New access permission string.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Medical record metadata updated successfully"
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "reason"
    }

Constraints:
    - The record must exist.
    - Only allowed fields (description, access_permission) will be updated.
    - At least one field must be provided to update.

function.name: detach_record_from_appointment
function.description:
Removes the association between a medical record (record_id) and a specific appointment (appointment_id).

Args:
    record_id (str): The unique identifier of the medical record.
    appointment_id (str): The unique identifier of the appointment.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Medical record detached from appointment."
    }
    OR
    dict: {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure
    }

Constraints:
    - Only authorized actions are allowed (authorization is assumed here).
    - Both record and appointment must exist.
    - The medical record must actually be associated with the given appointment.

bad_patterns: 在环境 env_182_rl中，upload_medical_record 跳过 check_file_type_and_size_validity / check_record_access_permission，或未 associate_record_with_appointment。
skills: 使用环境 env_182_rl时，get_patient_info 与 get_upcoming_appointments 选中目标就诊。上传前 check_file_type_and_size_validity 和 check_record_access_permission，成功后 associate_record_with_appointment，再用 get_medical_records_for_appointment 回读。

function.name: find_participant_by_name
function.description:
Retrieve participant information by name.

Args:

Returns:
    dict: {

    }

        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure (invalid input)
    }

Constraints:
    - Name is matched case-insensitively.
    - Multiple participants with the same name are all returned.
    - If name is empty or not a string, returns an error.

function.name: get_participant_by_id
function.description:
Retrieve full details for the participant with the given participant_id.

Args:
    participant_id (str): The unique participant identifier.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": ParticipantInfo,
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str,  # "Participant not found"
    }

Constraints:
    - The participant_id must exist in the system.

function.name: list_all_participants
function.description:
List all registered participants in the support group management system.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[ParticipantInfo],  # List of all participant info records (may be empty)
    }

Constraints:
    - No specific constraints; returns all registered participants.

function.name: get_meeting_by_topic
function.description:
Search and return all meetings that match the given topic.

Args:
    topic (str): The topic to filter meetings by.

Returns:
    dict:
        - success (bool): True if query is valid.
        - data (list): Each element is {

            "schedule": str,
            "venue": str  # venue_id
          } for each matching meeting.

        If topic is invalid (none or empty), return success False and error message.

Constraints:

    - Returns all matching meetings, even if multiple.

function.name: get_meeting_by_schedule_and_venue
function.description:
Find all meetings scheduled at a given time and venue.

Args:
    schedule (str): The scheduled time string of the meeting.
    venue_id (str): The identifier for the venue.

Returns:
    dict:

        }

            "success": False,
            "error": str   # Explanation (e.g. "Venue not found")
        }

Constraints:

    - Returns all meetings with a matching schedule and venue.

function.name: get_meeting_by_code
function.description:
Retrieve meeting details given a meeting_code.

Args:
    meeting_code (str): The unique access code of the meeting.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": MeetingInfo,  # Details of the matching meeting
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # No meeting found with the specified code
    }

Constraints:
    - Each meeting_code is unique to a meeting.

function.name: get_meeting_details
function.description:
Retrieve full details for a meeting by its meeting_id, including topic, schedule,
venue details (address, room_number, capacity), participants (names), meeting_code, and recurrence pattern.

Args:
    meeting_id (str): The unique identifier for the meeting.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": {
            "meeting_id": str,
            "topic": str,
            "schedule": str,
            "venue": {
                "venue_id": str,
                "address": str,
                "room_number": str,
                "capacity": int
            },
            "meeting_code": str,

        }
    }

        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure
    }

Constraints:
    - meeting_id must exist within the system.
